jobs.title: Project Manager V
jobs.description:
Position Purpose:
In this role, you will collaborate with internal teams, leadership, and external stakeholders to drive the complex integration process, analyze key business metrics, and ensure a smooth transition and alignment with company goals. Success in the role requires a powerful combination of project management and business analysis skills, a confident approach to guiding stakeholders, and expertise in handling the specific challenges of integrating newly acquired companies.

Key Details
: The role is fully remote within the United States. Must be authorized to work in the U.S. without the need for employment-based visa sponsorship now or in the future. Sponsorship and future sponsorship are not available for this opportunity, including employment-based visa types H-1B, L-1, O-1, H-1B1, F-1, J-1, OPT, or CPT.

Manage the full project life cycle, including review of various sources to assess requirements, creation of project plans and schedules, obtaining and managing resources, managing budget, and facilitating project execution, deployment and closure.
Utilize corporate and industry standard project management tools and techniques to effectively manage projects. Establish and maintain corporate project management methodology and other department procedures.
Communicate project status to all stakeholders and external agencies.
Negotiate with project stakeholders to identify resources, resolve issues, and mitigate risks.
Build toolkits, standard procedures, and training materials.
Provide functional and technical knowledge across multiple business and technical areas.
Manage the creation of all project deliverables to ensure adherence to quality standards including design documents, test plans, training materials, and operations documentation.

Education/Experience

Bachelor’s degree in related field or equivalent experience.
8+ years of project management experience with departmental specific projects.
Previous experience as a lead in a functional area, managing cross functional teams on large scale projects or supervisory experience including hiring, training, assigning work and managing the performance of staff.
Proficient with MS-Office applications. Healthcare and managed care experience preferred.
Understanding of Agile methodology is preferred.
Preferred: Experience using AI tools like ChatGPT or Copilot in day-to-day work.

Pay Range: $107,700.00 - $199,300.00 per year

At Centene, we connect people to the care they need to live healthier lives — and the work you do here makes that impact real every day.
You’ll take on meaningful challenges that directly support individuals, families, and communities, building your skills while making healthcare more accessible and effective. It’s work with a purpose you can see, backed by a team committed to improving lives well beyond the workday.

Centene offers a comprehensive benefits package including: competitive pay, health insurance, 401K and stock purchase plans, tuition reimbursement, paid time off plus holidays, and a flexible approach to work with remote, hybrid, field or office work schedules. Actual pay will be adjusted based on an individual's skills, experience, education, and other job-related factors permitted by law, including full-time or part-time status. Total compensation may also include additional forms of incentives. Benefits may be subject to program eligibility.

Centene is an equal opportunity employer that is committed to diversity, and values the ways in which we are different. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, or other characteristic protected by applicable law.

Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered in accordance with the LA County Ordinance and the California Fair Chance Act

jobs.title: EMEA & APAC  Technical Project Manager
jobs.description:
Job ID:
19149

Alternate Locations:

Newell Brands is a leading $8.3B consumer products company with a portfolio of iconic brands such as Graco®, Coleman®, Oster®, Rubbermaid® and Sharpie®, and 25,000 talented employees around the world. Our high-performance culture, unparalleled curiosity about the world around us, and talented people fuel our success. Our culture is enabled through our core values which guide all we do and how we win as One Newell. They are Integrity, Teamwork, Passion for Winning, Ownership & Leadership.

Technical Project Manager, Digital Operations – Operational Excellence Engineering, EMEA & APAC

Purpose of the role

Join our regional Operational Excellence Engineering Digital team and play a key role in accelerating digital transformation across our manufacturing network in EMEA & APAC.

Our team owns and develops the shared regional platform connecting machine data, orchestration, analytics and business systems, providing manufacturing sites with the standards and capabilities they need to turn digital solutions into tangible operational improvements.

You own the execution, in support of the direction and platform architecture set by the Regional Program Lead. You join a small regional team where you help make this a reality, pushing the digital maturity of the region forward by aligning site needs with central requirements. If you want to build something that works in real factories, with people who care that it does, you will fit here.

This is a highly collaborative role for someone who enjoys connecting technology, manufacturing operations and people, bringing structure to a fast-growing program and making things happen across multiple countries and stakeholders.

Key responsibilities

Coordinate rollouts across manufacturing sites: schedules, dependencies, site readiness and open actions.
Run the demand intake: gather and structure requests from sites and business teams and prepare them for prioritisation by the Regional Program Lead.
Translate site requirements into solutions together with the technical team (machine data connectivity, CMMS, reporting, system integrations).
Coordinate external contractor delivery from scope definition and planning through progress tracking and handover to internal owners.
Support the implementation of regional digital standards across sites, including KPI definitions, templates and applications, and close adoption gaps.
Act as the connection point between manufacturing sites and the regional program: surface challenges, coordinate decisions and ensure follow-through.
Organise key-user training and capability building with internal and external trainers, and monitor adoption across sites.
Provide clear, consolidated program reporting: progress, risks, dependencies and decisions required.
As the data platform grows: analyse site data and build Power BI dashboards that support operational decisions.

What we’re looking for

You are a project manager or business analyst with a solid technical base, comfortable operating at the intersection of technology, manufacturing and business.

You Bring

Around five years of experience in a digital, data or technology environment, in project management, business analysis or a comparable role.
Enough technical understanding to work with specialists and follow a project independently: exposure to programming or low-code tools (Node-RED or similar), databases, Power BI or other BI tools, cloud platforms, DevOps. You do not need to be an expert in each.
Strong analytical skills; comfortable working with data and turning it into insight.
A proven ability to coordinate multi-stakeholder initiatives across sites, functions and external partners.
Excellent organisational and follow-through skills, with a structured and documentation-oriented approach.
Strong communication skills and the confidence to engage with site teams, leadership, central functions, IT and vendors.
A collaborative, enabling mindset: you know how to influence and coordinate without direct authority.
Motivation to learn: the platform and the tools keep evolving, and so will you.
Professional fluency in English.
Experience in a manufacturing or industrial environment is a strong plus, not a requirement.

What will make you successful

You don’t need to be the deepest technical expert in one specific technology. What matters is your ability to understand the technical landscape, connect the right people and turn priorities into execution.

You are someone who brings clarity to complexity, keeps multiple workstreams moving, takes a challenge and works out how to move it forward, and enjoys seeing digital solutions successfully adopted in real manufacturing environments.

Newell Brands (NASDAQ: NWL) is a leading global consumer goods company with a strong portfolio of well-known brands, including Rubbermaid, Sharpie, Graco, Coleman, Rubbermaid Commercial Products, Yankee Candle, Paper Mate, FoodSaver, Dymo, EXPO, Elmer’s, Oster, NUK, Spontex and Campingaz. We are focused on delighting consumers by lighting up everyday moments.

jobs.description:
Project Manager – IBM Z Mainframe Software Migration

Remote working with occasional travel to Canberra
12-month contract with potential extension up to 24 months
Australian Citizens only

We are partnering with a reputable consulting organisation on a Federal Government project who require an experienced Project Manager to support complex software migration projects across the IBM Z mainframe platform.

This opportunity will suit a technically capable Project Manager with strong delivery, stakeholder management and risk management experience. Previous exposure to IBM Z, mainframe technologies or enterprise software migration projects will be highly regarded.

About the Role

You will provide end-to-end project management across one or more software migration workstreams, working closely with the Program Manager, technical delivery teams and customer stakeholders.
You will be responsible for developing and maintaining project plans, coordinating resources, managing scope and schedules, monitoring risks and ensuring contractual deliverables are achieved.
The role can be performed remotely, although occasional travel to client sites in Canberra may be required.

Key Responsibilities

Manage one or more workstreams within IBM Z software migration projects.
Consult with the Program Manager and review project proposals to confirm objectives, timeframes, funding constraints and resource requirements.
Develop and maintain detailed project plans covering delivery activities, milestones, dependencies and resources.
Manage project scope, cost, schedules, risks, changes and contractual deliverables.
Coordinate cross-functional technical teams throughout project planning and execution.
Provide clear reporting on project progress, scope changes, risks, challenges and delivery requirements.
Communicate project status, milestones and risks to internal program leadership and customer stakeholders.
Support decision-makers and implementation teams in maintaining consistent business and mission-focused objectives.
Apply effective project governance, tracking, change control and risk management practices.
Organise competing priorities and adapt delivery plans as project requirements change.

Skills & Experience

To be successful in this role, you will have:
At least five years of technical project management experience.
Current PMP or PRINCE2 certification.
Demonstrated knowledge of project management and operational delivery practices.
Experience managing cross-functional technical teams.
Proven responsibility for managing project scope, cost, schedules and contractual deliverables.
Strong experience in project planning, tracking, change control and risk management.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
Strong stakeholder engagement and customer-facing communication skills.
Well-developed negotiation skills.
The ability to manage competing priorities and adapt effectively to change.

Highly Desirable

Project delivery experience within an IBM Z mainframe environment.
Experience working with IBM Z software products.
Previous involvement in enterprise software migration projects.
An understanding of application development on IBM Z.
Exposure to COBOL, PL/I or other mainframe programming technologies.
An existing or previously held Australian Federal Government security clearance.

What’s on Offer?

Initial 12-month contract.
Potential extension for a total engagement of up to 24 months.
Remote working supported.
Opportunity to deliver important software migration projects for a Federal Government institution.
Work across complex IBM Z mainframe environments.
Collaboration with experienced program, technical and customer stakeholders.

If you are an experienced Technical Project Manager with IBM Z, mainframe or enterprise software migration experience, we would welcome the opportunity to speak with you.

Apply today or reach out for a confidential discussion: Katrina Gabriel | 0489 923 756 | katrinag@whizdom.com.au

Candidates must be Australian Citizens and will need to be willing to undergo pre-employment screening checks. These may include identity and work-rights verification, security clearance checks and any additional screening requested by the client.

With our three market leading businesses, world-class operations and investments in research and development, we offer capabilities and opportunity no one else can. Together, we push the boundaries of known science and find new ways to connect and protect our world. Join us and help shape the future of aerospace and defense.

What You Will Do 

As the Manager of Accelerated Leadership Development, you will play a pivotal role in shaping the future of leadership within our organization. You will support the Program Management Leader in the global delivery of impactful development programs for high-potential talent, ensuring alignment with business needs and organizational goals. Your expertise will drive the success of our leadership pipeline and enhance the learner experience.  

Program Readiness:  

Support the Program Management Lead in the creation and maintenance of the program management project plan throughout the lifecycle of the program. Track action items and milestones to closure.  
Lead pre-program milestone readiness reviews to confirm participant enrollment, facilitator preparation, materials, technology, and logistics are complete. 
Attend recurring meetings with the program vendor partners and track closure of action items.  
Provide program status updates for weekly reporting and macro plan updates.  

Attendee Management:  

Maintain attendee roster data for leadership development program participants 
Track confirmations of leaders requested to join the leadership development program for engagement opportunities. Request and track leader inputs (biographies, dietary restrictions, and availability of preparation meetings).

Data maintenance:

Maintain organization of program file documentation in the SharePoint repository. 

Participant communication:  

Manage the program team mailbox, serving as a primary point of contact for participant questions by responding to inquiries, resolving issues, or escalating to the appropriate point of contact as needed, while ensuring a seamless participant experience.
Track completion status of participant pre-work actions and follow up to ensure timely closure.  

Learning systems:

Manage architecture of program setup structure in the learning management system.
Track program attendance and completions.
Work with Learning Operations team to load attendance data into learning systems. 

Post-program follow-through:  

Coordinate post-program participant evaluations, participant follow-up, action items, and program closeout activities.
Analyze participant evaluation feedback, summarize into top themes, and assist Program Manager with activities to continually improve the program experience and delivery.
Support the Program Management Lead throughout program after action reviews (AARs) with key sponsors and stakeholders. 

Standardization:

Develop and maintain program playbooks, standard operating procedures, templates, and checklists to ensure consistent delivery across cohorts. 

Program session support:

Support onsite delivery of multi-day program sessions at major program partner locations as needed
Up to 40% travel

Experience in project and program management, including developing actionable plans, managing timelines, mitigating risks, engaging stakeholders, and driving measurable outcomes.
Proven ability to manage multiple concurrent priorities, maintain visibility of critical paths and dependencies, and use data-driven analysis to generate actionable insights.
Experience supporting accelerated or high-potential talent development programs and delivering executive-level communications and presentations.
High proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, including creating executive-ready presentations, developing visual content, and preparing professional communication materials.

jobs.title: Technology Project Manager (Temporary)
jobs.description:
Job Description

The University of Washington’s Office of Research has an outstanding opportunity for a Sr. Technology Project Manager. This position is a 1-year term appointment with opportunity to renew.

About This Opportunity

Reporting to the Agile PMO Manager the Sr. Technology Project Manager is responsible for developing, directing, managing, and coordinating software integration and development projects for researcher specific projects. The person in this role will facilitate consensus among a diverse group of business owners and stakeholders. They will be responsible for development and implementation of project management approaches that meet agreed upon business goals. Successful candidates must possess outstanding independent judgment in prioritizing critical information, and discretion and diplomacy in working within the larger University of Washington (UW) administrative environment.

Key Responsibilities

Project Management (70%)

Working with resources to define scope, risks and objectives of major releases, individual projects and project phases; develop schedules and budgets, and monitor progress and risk across multiple streams
Ensure project teams have adequate resources, skills and support to successfully deliver on prioritized efforts
Serve software development team(s) as Scrum Master, facilitating Scrum ceremonies, removing impediments, coordinating feature development, testing, release and communications across product teams
Promote agile project management and software development best practices.
Meet regularly with internal and external stakeholders to schedule projects/features based on prioritization from managers
Lead, organize and influence positively and effectively, working through unstructured problems and creating the structure necessary to drive for results
Facilitate resolution of issues within the project decision making structure, determining appropriate escalation and resolution of issues
Provide overall project leadership and management, including managing scope of projects, schedules and budgets, and generating status reports
Direct, create, and implement project plans, status updates, risk mitigation plans and other planning materials to support project execution and control activities
Provide direct and indirect oversight for assigned projects
Evaluate resources needed for project and make recommendations/requests
Work with all levels of management to critically evaluate and communicate business issues/risks to campus clients and team members
Implement appropriate process and policies to collect and report metrics on project performance
Initiate project proposals when existing products need to be upgraded or replaced or products need to be built or acquired to fill gaps
Advise on the impact of novel, developing, and mature applications of IT solutions as they relate to research at the University of Washington

Analysis (15%)

Review requirements gathered from stakeholder and system user interviews to ensure approaches and solutions are linked to objectives and future needs and to uncover gaps clients may not have identified
Analyze problems and risks, formulate conclusions, and make recommendations
Define parameters of metrics to measure impact of projects, determine means of measure, report results
Lead standing and ad hoc workgroups to define business needs and potential solutions
Use agile methodologies to break complex feature requirements into manageable chunks of work that deliver value to the end user
Create artifacts as needed to support clear understanding of business needs, to include business process diagrams, use cases, scenarios, tasks and workflow analysis
Facilitate discussions with stakeholders and subject matter experts, to develop shared understanding of needs and build consensus related to priorities and requirements, and develop inclusive solutions that thoughtfully balance trade-offs and benefits among process partners
Document functional requirements, user interaction requirements, non-functional requirements, specifications, and acceptance criteria to support software development, quality assurance, support and learning materials, and other downstream development support processes

Process Improvement (10%)

Facilitate and encourage ongoing process improvement with partners such as UW IT, OSP, GCA, EH&S and others to improve overall approach to software development, delivery, and ongoing end-user support
Stay informed and recommend process and/or system changes to meet changing ORIS needs
Identify process and supporting technical solutions to streamline business processes, improve efficiency and simplify the administrative process for faculty and staff users

Other Duties as Assigned (5%)

Minimum Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Computer Science Information Science, or a related field
4-5 years of experience in project management/business analysis or in a role performing progressively more complex and responsible tasks involving project leadership and analysis
Experience managing, leading and participating in progressively more complex projects/product development
Demonstrated experience with project management methodologies and best practices including project planning, resource management, consensus building, and process improvement
Demonstrated experience with project management over vendor product technical implementations. Cavendish

jobs.description:
The Opportunity

As Talent Program Manager, you will play a critical role in translating Ulteig’s talent and development priorities into practical, high-impact programs and solutions that build organizational capability and support business needs. Reporting to the L&D Manager, this role independently leads assigned talent development programs from design through implementation, measurement, and continuous improvement. Working with business leaders, HR partners, and external partners, you will assess needs, identify root causes and opportunities, recommend solutions, and make informed program-level decisions that balance business needs, stakeholder input, risks, and available resources.

What You Will Do

Employee and Leadership Development

Leads the design, implementation, and continuous improvement of assigned employee and leadership development programs. Working within enterprise L&D priorities and in partnership with Talent and Business Leaders, this role translates organizational needs into practical solutions, learning experiences, and resources that build capability and support business objectives. Serves as both a program leader and facilitator, bringing strategic thinking and strong execution to the programs and initiatives within its scope.

Partners with L&D leadership, Talent partners, Business leaders, and key stakeholders to diagnose current and future capability needs, identify gaps and root causes, and recommend solutions aligned with business needs and enterprise L&D priorities.
Independently leads assigned employee and leadership development programs from design through execution and continuous improvement, establishing clear plans, milestones, stakeholder responsibilities, dependencies, and measures of success. Proactively identifies and addresses risks, gaps, and downstream impacts throughout the lifecycle of the work.
Translates enterprise development priorities into effective program strategies, content, curricula, learning experiences, and supporting resources, determining the appropriate approach based on the business and participant needs.
Establishes sustainment strategies, success measures, and feedback mechanisms to evaluate program effectiveness and business impact, using insights to continuously improve program design and outcomes.
Partners with internal stakeholders and vendors to design, customize, and deliver learning solutions that address identified business and capability needs and complement Ulteig's broader development offerings.
Exercises sound, independent judgment in program-level decisions, balancing business needs, stakeholder input, risks, available resources, and established priorities; appropriately escalates decisions with broader strategic, portfolio, or resource implications.
Adheres to facilitation and adult learning best practices to ensure impactful learning experiences and retention of material by participants.
Trains other facilitators on best practices and ensures regular evaluation of all facilitated content for continuous improvement.
Supports organizational change initiatives by designing and delivering learning, engagement, and upskilling solutions.
Establishes and maintains program standards, processes, and resources that drive quality, consistency, scalability, and continuous improvement, ensuring deliverables are accurate, complete, well considered, and ready for stakeholder review.
Independently manage complex, cross-functional initiatives with clear plans, milestones, dependencies, stakeholder responsibilities, and follow-through.

Mentoring Programs

Leads the design, management, and continuous improvement of Ulteig’s mentoring programs to support employee and leader development.

Develops and maintains mentoring resources and processes, including an effective approach for matching mentee learning objectives/needs with potential mentors.
Evaluates when mentoring is the appropriate talent solution and recommends blended or alternative learning approaches based on the business and employee needs.
Works with HR Business Partners to help facilitate mentoring matches.

Integrated Employee Development

Partners with internal stakeholders and HR colleagues to connect learning and development with broader talent programs and business needs, including Career Development Plans, succession planning, employee survey feedback, strategic initiatives, goal setting, and performance reviews. Proactively identifies opportunities to integrate learning and development solutions with broader talent processes and business needs, recommending approaches that strengthen alignment and impact.

Evaluates and prioritizes learning requests based on business needs, organizational impact, available capacity, and established L&D priorities.
Effectively manages time, competing priorities, and commitments to ensure agreed-upon deliverables and timelines are met.
Supports offsite planning and execution with learning content as applicable.
May support additional programs or duties, as assigned.

What We Expect From You

Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Organizational Development or related field, or equivalent experience
5+ years of experience leading the design, development, and management of talent development programs, or related experience that provides equivalent knowledge is required, with 7+ years of experience preferred
Strong understanding of leading practices and innovations in talent management
Demonstrated ability to independently lead complex, cross-functional programs and projects from planning through execution, including stakeholder alignment, project planning, risk management, decision-making, follow-through, and measurement of outcomes.
Confidence and demonstrated ability to facilitate engaging virtual and in-person learning experiences for audiences ranging from individual contributors to senior leaders.
Strong strategic thinking, analytical, and problem-solving skills, with a demonstrated ability to diagnose needs, identify root causes, evaluate options, and recommend solutions aligned with business objectives.
Understanding of adult learning principles and creative training development approaches
Ability to travel 25%
Excellent verbal and written communication skills
Strong program and project management skills, with demonstrated ability to prioritize competing needs, anticipate risks and dependencies, maintain attention to detail, and deliver high-quality work with limited direction.
Demonstrated initiative and ability to operate independently within the scope of the role, proactively addressing issues and recognizing when broader strategic, portfolio, or resource decisions require input or escalation.
Proficient with Microsoft Office Suite or related software
Demonstrates openness to innovation by embracing and applying evolving technology and AI tools to enhance workflows, solve problems, and drive continuous improvement
Must have authorization to work permanently in the U.S.

As you consider applying for a position at Ulteig, we encourage you to think outside the box – because we do! You might not meet 100% of the skills listed in a description, but we are committed to hiring people with exceptional talent, ability and potential, and then creating an environment where they can become the best versions of themselves. We don’t want to miss out on the possibility of speaking with the next outstanding Ulteig team member, so please apply if you think this role is a great match for your unique skills and strengths. And, yes, relevant military experience is absolutely considered for transitioning service members.

What You Can Expect From Ulteig

Ulteig is a purpose driven organization that has built a culture focused on people – both our clients and our employees –for over 80 years. Working at Ulteig is more than a job, opening opportunities to make an impact by creating and solving for a sustainable future. We recognize our success relies heavily on the dedication and focus of our workforce; this is why we make investing in our employees a top priority. We prioritize flexibility and staying connected to meet your needs and help you achieve your goals. We value your unique perspective, respect your individuality and celebrate your contributions. At Ulteig, we take our own success and the success of our clients personally.

We offer our team members:

Flexible Workplace
Employee Ownership
Competitive Pay
Comprehensive Benefits Package
Collaborative Environment
Innovative Culture

Our vision is to be the most trusted partners transforming our world’s critical infrastructure. Ulteig connects people and resources to develop compelling, integrated solutions across multiple Lifeline Sectors®, including Power, Renewables, Transportation and Water. Ulteig is a trusted partner in engineering North America’s essential infrastructure and leverages its expertise with a wide range of public and private clients.

At Ulteig, we care deeply about our team, listening to their needs and ensuring they have the tools necessary to be productive whether they choose to work remotely, hybrid or in office. Regardless of where you work, you are empowered to build a workday that best suits your strengths. We strive to ensure a balance and separation between home and work life. If you would like to be a part of a company that empowers their employees, apply today!

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. At Notion, we believe in building software that adapts to how people work, not the other way around. As we scale globally, we need someone who can ensure our revenue teams are equipped with the knowledge, tools, and processes to succeed across every geography while maintaining our core values and approach to customer relationships.

We're looking for a Revenue Enablement Program Manager to turn our global enablement strategy into repeatable programs that drive measurable changes in how our revenue teams work. You'll maintain a consistent global core while tailoring examples, facilitation, sequencing, and practice to the market.

You'll partner with Sales Leadership, Revenue Operations, Product Marketing, onboarding teams, and frontline managers to equip the field with the skills, workflows, and just-in-time guidance to execute our GTM strategy. Equinix is the world’s digital infrastructure company®, shortening the path to connectivity to enable the innovations that enrich our work, life and planet.

A place where bold ideas are welcomed, human connection is valued, and everyone has the opportunity to shape their future.

A career at Equinix means being at the center of shaping what comes next and amplifying customer value through innovation and impact. You’ll work across teams, influence key decisions, and help shape the path forward. Job Summary

We're looking for a Senior Staff Technical Program Manager to join Equinix's Digital and Innovation Office. This is a senior individual contributor role for an experienced program manager who has spent years running complex, multi-team programs and knows how to get things done across organizational boundaries with limited oversight.

You'll lead complex, high-priority, cross-functional programs end to end, work across technical and business teams, and help shape how program management is practiced across DIO. You will also mentor other junior project and program managers within the PMO.

Critically, we're looking for someone who is actively curious about how AI tools can make program management faster, more thorough, and more scalable and who can put that curiosity to practical use.

Data center operations domains: Energy and sustainability, design and construction, digital twins, infrastructure monitoring, capacity planning

jobs.description:
Description

Amazon Catalog Services builds the systems that host and run the world’s largest e-Commerce catalog. Within this organization, Product Knowledge (PK) is responsible for mining, modeling, storing and vending the product catalog metadata. This metadata (schema) governs all the possible product information and powers Amazon end-to-end processes, starting on how we organize products, how we define all possible product attributes, how we guide selling partners when listing them, all the way to power customer shopping experiences (e.g., product overview in detail pages, browse taxonomy, search and navigation filters). If you've ever shopped on Amazon, you interacted with our product.

We are investing in an initiative to help scale different Amazon Businesses. This includes performing agentic orchestration replicating system and manual decisions across Catalog components. These investments will encompass aligning stakeholders on a strategy, driving workstreams across platform infrastructure, agent creation, orchestration, enabling products across Catalog, Listings, SX, CX and measurements of impact. We are hiring a Principal Technical Program Manager (PTPM) for this charter in Seattle to lead the initiative.

As a Principal TPM in this role, you will collaborate closely with leaders, managers, engineers and scientists to deliver solutions into production, establish partnerships with other organizations such as Retail, Category businesses, Selling Partner Services, Detail Page CX, Search, to prioritize and translate the business requirements into technical specifications. You will have end to end ownership - from defining the strategy, working across engineering teams to build the solution, and monitoring progress across the entire Amazon eCommerce pipeline. You will provide direct visibility to senior leadership on all aspects of your programs, drive cross team collaboration, and prioritize initiatives that are crucial to businesses.

Key job responsibilities

Define and deliver large-scale, cross-organizational programs by establishing clear goals, managing dependencies, mitigating risks, and driving execution across multiple engineering and business teams.
Own and evolve technology roadmaps for complex systems, identifying gaps and opportunities across architectures and organizations while decomposing intricate problems into practical, scalable solutions.
Drive system-level and business reviews, aligning teams toward coherent technology strategies, effective engineering processes, and long-term operational improvements.
Partner with leaders at all levels to communicate complex trade-offs, influence priorities, and build consensus on technical direction — representing decisions clearly in both written and verbal formats.
Create and optimize the mechanisms necessary for sustained program success, including cross-functional communication frameworks, stakeholder alignment processes, and data-driven decision-making practices.

About The Team

The Catalog Services Product Knowledge organization is responsible for building systems that create and manage the e-commerce schema. We are expanding to support more Business Use Cases across Amazon. The initiative will cross boundaries across Catalog teams, Selling Partner Services, downstream clients, etc. The team is looking for an experiences Principal TPM with strong technical background, operating with autonomy capable of resolving problems, mitigating risks and leading large a program with a broad number of stakeholders.

Basic Qualifications

7+ years of technical product or program management experience
10+ years of working directly with engineering teams experience
5+ years of software development experience
Experience managing programs across cross functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules

Preferred Qualifications

8+ years of hands-on work managing complex technology projects experience
10+ years of technical program management experience
Experience in architectural design or system design independent of an architect
Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition

jobs.title: Sr. Technical Program Manager, Network Product Development, Interconnects
jobs.description:
Description

AWS builds one of the largest networks in the world, and every rack that lands in a data center depends on optics, copper, fiber and switches all arriving on time. The Network Product Development (NPD) Interconnects team designs and brings to production the optical modules, DAC/AEC copper cables and structured fiber that connect AWS infrastructure.

We are looking for a Senior Technical Program Manager to help drive how our products move from forecast to factory to data center. You will be the day-to-day interface between Supply Chain, our manufacturing vendors and the NPD engineers who design our products. You make sure each group has the technical context, data and decisions it needs from the others. When a forecast changes, a supplier raises a constraint or a build stalls, you bring the right people together quickly, frame the trade-offs clearly and drive the issue to resolution.

We work quickly and practically. Rather than waiting for large software programs, you will use AI tools, agents, scripts and lightweight workflows to stand up working processes fast. You'll run them on a regular cadence with our partners and improve them as you learn. Once a process has proven itself, you will help turn it into durable tooling.

Key job responsibilities

Drive the end-to-end program for interconnect products (optical modules, DAC/AEC, fiber and structured cabling) from forecast to delivery, and report progress and risks to NPD and Networking leadership through a regular business review.
Act as the primary interface between Supply Chain, vendors and NPD engineering. Translate engineering constraints into supply implications and supply constraints into engineering decisions.
Coordinate technical review of significant forecast changes (product mix or volume) with engineering and Supply Chain before they are shared with suppliers.
Help keep long-range capacity commitments and short-range build signals distinct. Raise it early when an execution signal risks undoing a long-lead commitment (DSPs, lasers, PCBs, raw fiber materials, line capacity).
Partner with engineering and Supply Chain to keep BOM and allocation data consistent, so sub-tier requirements line up across commodity managers.
Run scenario analyses (for example a 50% demand increase or decrease) with Supply Chain and engineering to show where commitments break across components and sub-tiers, and help teams agree on the response.
Work with vendors and Supply Chain to track supplier commitments and de-commitments for critical sub-tier parts
Drive a weekly clear-to-build (CTB) review with vendors and Supply Chain that combines component availability against the build plan, escalates shortfalls early and handles excess inventory without stopping the line.
Track capacity KPIs with our vendors. Work with engineering and site teams to validate capacity constraints when the data doesn't line up.
Coordinate with Supply Chain and deployment teams on inventory at VMI hubs and rack integrators, so production plans reflect where finished units can actually go.
Support rack integration improvements with engineering and integrators: rack portfolio standardization, production-readiness validation for new rack designs, first-pass yield, test time and the time from PO to start of assembly.
Use AI tools and agents every day to automate data gathering, reconcile vendor and Supply Chain data, generate status reports and catch issues early.
Build AI-assisted workflows that cut manual spreadsheet work for engineers and Supply Chain partners, and share what works across the team.
Write requirements and work with software teams to turn proven processes and AI-assisted workflows into durable tools.

A day in the life

Your week might start with a CTB review across optics and fiber vendors, where an AI agent you set up has already reconciled the latest vendor data and flagged a laser shortfall weeks ahead. You then pull Supply Chain and engineering together to work through what a forecast revision means for supplier agreements. Later you follow up with a vendor on a capacity constraint that doesn't match their reported output, and join a call with a rack integrator on why a high-volume configuration keeps failing first-pass test. You write clear updates for leadership and turn this week's manual fixes into next week's automated workflow. Expect regular travel between Seattle and the Bay Area, as well as to supplier and integrator sites, mostly in Asia.

About The Team

NPD Interconnects handles product development for the optics, copper and fiber that link AWS networks, from early engineering through NPI and volume production. We work closely with the NPD switch and software teams, Global Supply Management, fabric and deployment teams, and our manufacturing partners worldwide. We value strong partnerships, mechanisms over good intentions, and a "trust, but verify" approach to the data we rely on.

Basic Qualifications

5+ years of technical product or program management experience
7+ years of working directly with engineering teams experience
5+ years of project management disciplines including scope, schedule, budget, quality, along with risk and critical path management experience
Experience managing programs across cross functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules
Bachelor's degree in Operations, Supply Chain Management, Engineering, or another technical field
Experience working with large-scale data mining and reporting tools (i.e. SQL, MS Power Query, Python), or experience delivering forecasting, budgeting, and variance analysis, and data interpretation of results
Experience managing projects across cross functional teams, building sustainable processes and coordinating release schedules
5+ years of experience in hardware supply chain, manufacturing operations, or NPI for electronic, optical, or networking products
Experience working directly with ODMs, JDMs, or contract manufacturers on capacity, CTB, or production ramps

Preferred Qualifications

Experience defining KPI's/SLA's used to drive multi-million dollar businesses and reporting to senior leadership
Master's degree or above in Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Operations, Supply Chain, or Business Administration, or Master's degree or above in engineering, statistics, computer science, operations research, business analytics, information systems or equivalent
Experience communicating and presenting to senior leadership
Experience leveraging AI-powered tools or data analytics platforms to drive quality improvements, root cause analysis, or process optimization
Experience using AI-powered or data-driven scheduling and planning tools to optimize maintenance workflows
Experience with optical transceivers, DSP and laser supply, copper interconnects, or fiber cabling manufacturing
Experience with multi-tier BOMs, allocation, or sub-tier supply visibility for long-lead components
Experience with rack-level integration and test, yield improvement, or design for manufacturability

The opportunity

Join our EMEA Operations team as a Senior Project Manager and lead the successful delivery of Battery Energy Storage System (BESS) and complex energy infrastructure projects from contract award through final acceptance. In this role, you will drive execution, profitability, customer satisfaction and cross-functional collaboration, playing a key role in the energy transition across international markets.

How You'll Make An Impact

Lead the end-to-end execution of BESS and system integration projects, ensuring delivery against contractual commitments, budget, schedule, quality and safety targets.
Develop and manage project execution plans, integrated schedules, resource allocation and key milestones throughout the project lifecycle.
Coordinate multidisciplinary teams across engineering, procurement, manufacturing, logistics, installation, commissioning and service functions.
Drive project financial performance by managing revenues, costs, cash flow, forecasts, margins, risks and opportunities.
Manage scope changes, variation orders, claims and commercial negotiations while safeguarding project profitability.
Ensure contractual compliance, proactively identifying and mitigating risks related to obligations, deliverables, performance guarantees and acceptance criteria.
Oversee system integration activities, including interface management, FAT/SAT execution, commissioning and performance testing.
Act as the primary customer interface, building strong relationships and leading project reviews, steering committees and escalation management.
Provide leadership to international and multicultural project teams, fostering accountability, collaboration and continuous improvement.

Your background

Strong commercial and financial acumen, including budget management, forecasting, cash flow control, claims and change management.

About the company
Our client is an enterprise software company building a unified R&D platform for scientists. Chemists, materials scientists and biologists at leading industrial R&D organizations use it to speed up how new products are discovered, developed and brought to market, across chemicals, pharmaceuticals, advanced materials, and food and beverage. The company has about 130 people, has raised $27M, and runs a small, high-velocity implementation team where every person makes a real difference.

The role
You will own customer implementations from scoping to go-live, acting as the central point of contact for both the customer's R&D leadership and the internal delivery team. Successful, on-time rollouts are how customers start getting value from the platform.

What you'll do
• Own each customer implementation from initial scoping through go-live.
• Serve as the central point of contact for the customer's R&D leadership and the internal delivery team.

jobs.title: Gaming Program Manager
jobs.description:
Aquent has partnered with a world-renowned gaming studio to find a talented Technical Program Manager who will play a pivotal role in shaping the future of data and analytics for one of the most beloved gaming franchises in history. In this role, you will have a direct impact on how player data is leveraged to drive game development, optimize player experiences, and guide the studio's exciting journey into AI-assisted workflows. By bridging the gap between data science leaders, engineering teams, and studio stakeholders, you will transform complex data requirements into actionable roadmaps, ensuring that millions of players worldwide continue to enjoy seamless and engaging experiences.

The Opportunity

As a key driver of the analytics ecosystem, you will lead the planning and delivery of a robust data platform that powers studio-wide decision-making. You will collaborate closely with Data Science, Analytics, and Data Platform teams to align priorities, manage backlogs, and streamline delivery. This is an incredible opportunity to work at the intersection of gaming, data engineering, and cutting-edge AI, helping to implement practical AI-assisted workflows and trusted data foundations with a strong focus on security, privacy, and responsible technology adoption.

What You Will Do

Own the analytics environment roadmap and demand intake, balancing studio initiatives, stakeholder requests, and long-term platform investments.
Drive monthly Kanban-based planning and end-to-end feature delivery, keeping priorities, commitments, and milestones on track.
Partner with Data Science and Analytics leaders to align delivery plans, governance, and dependencies supporting model development, training, optimization, and reporting.
Coordinate with upstream data platform teams to capture gaps in data sources, capabilities, or services, tracking requirements through to completion.
Translate complex information needs and analytics requests into clear Azure DevOps (ADO) features and backlog items.
Track delivery and cross-team dependencies, keeping leadership and partner teams informed of progress, timelines, and commitments.
Work with technical leads to prioritize practical AI and Machine Learning use cases and their trusted, reusable data foundations.
Support focused trials of AI-assisted planning, documentation, and delivery workflows, coordinating human reviews and capturing lessons learned.

What You Bring (Required Qualifications)

Proven experience in project or program management, specifically within analytics, data platforms, or data-heavy environments.
Demonstrated success delivering technical programs, including capturing requirements and coordinating cross-team dependencies.
Familiarity with data platforms and analytics workflows, with a strong awareness of security, privacy, and data quality considerations.
Solid experience with Agile delivery models, backlog management, and hands-on use of Azure DevOps (ADO) or similar tools.
Working knowledge of SQL to explore data and clarify requirements with technical teams.
Strong organizational, prioritization, and stakeholder management skills.

Bonus Points (Preferred Qualifications)

Experience coordinating a shared data or analytics platform roadmap with upstream teams and downstream users across multiple technical teams.
Familiarity with AI/ML use cases, data science workflows, and the model lifecycle.
Exposure to data engineering and analytics engineering practices.
Experience using AI-assisted tools in program management or related workflows, with attention to responsible AI practices.
Experience supporting early-stage technology adoption through focused trials and incremental rollout.
Prior experience in the gaming industry or working with high-scale consumer digital products.
Ability to thrive and operate effectively in ambiguous, fast-scaling environments.

Client Description:

Join a global technology leader driving innovation and empowering people and organizations worldwide to achieve more. Here, you'll collaborate with passionate, diverse teams to create impactful solutions that shape the future. The culture prioritizes growth, inclusion, and purpose—where your ideas are valued, and your work drives real change. Wherever your passion lies and wherever your career is headed—you’ll play a role in projects that touch billions of lives. With flexible work options and a supportive environment, you'll have the tools to thrive both personally and professionally. Be part of something that truly matters.

jobs.title: Senior Technology Program Manager
jobs.description:
Who are we?

Equinix is the world’s digital infrastructure company®, shortening the path to connectivity to enable the innovations that enrich our work, life and planet.

A place where bold ideas are welcomed, human connection is valued, and everyone has the opportunity to shape their future.

A career at Equinix means being at the center of shaping what comes next and amplifying customer value through innovation and impact. You’ll work across teams, influence key decisions, and help shape the path forward. You’ll find belonging, purpose, and a team that welcomes you—because when you feel valued, you’re empowered to do your best work.

About The Role

We're looking for a Senior Staff Technical Program Manager to join Equinix's Digital and Innovation Office. This is a senior individual contributor role for an experienced program manager who has spent years running complex, multi-team programs and knows how to get things done across organizational boundaries — with limited oversight.

You'll lead complex, high-priority, cross-functional programs end to end, work across technical and business teams, and help shape how program management is practiced across DIO. You will also mentor other junior project and program managers within the PMO. Critically, we're looking for someone who is actively curious about how AI tools can make program management faster, more thorough, and more scalable — and who can put that curiosity to practical use.

What You'll Do

Project, Program, & Portfolio Execution 

Own, shape, and drive complex, cross-functional technology programs through the full technology development lifecycle (scope, schedule, change, risk, procurement, vendor, and closure)
Assess and recommend the right delivery approach (Agile, Waterfall, hybrid, SAFe) based on program needs
Manage multiple workstreams, risks and inter-dependencies, budgets, and timelines simultaneously – in collaboration with other program/ portfolio managers, if applicable
Proactively identify and resolve blockers at the program level, including issues that cut across teams or organizations
Lead effort estimation, resource planning, and capacity alignment with senior stakeholders
Conduct structured retrospectives and translate learnings into lasting process improvements

Stakeholder Management

Build working relationships with senior leaders, directors, and VP-level stakeholders across technical and business functions ensuring stakeholder alignment and business readiness through influence without authority so you drive the change
Define and publish communication plans, facilitate decision making and resolve cross-team conflicts before they become program risks
Lead or support steering committees, program reviews, and executive briefings
Leverage concise, sharp, and executive-ready content to convey current state of affairs and drive required outcomes

Governance & Reporting 

Effectively and proactively monitor and report program progress and health, milestones, risks and mitigation, scope changes, resource needs and decisions
Create and use JIRA or other tool-based dashboards to visualize program related data
Ensure compliance with internal controls, standards, and documentation practices 
Support vendor management and third-party integrations, where applicable 
Track and report financial data, program metrics, and operational effectiveness

Agile Delivery & Facilitation 

Use your strong command over multiple PM methodologies (Agile, Scrum, SAFe, Waterfall, Kanban) to determine the best approach for a given program and apply them correctly
Lead 3-5 agile teams as an RTE (release train engineer)
Coach teams on Agile best practices and metrics (velocity, burndown, backlog health,) using Jira/Confluence 
Facilitate scrum of scrums and structure work delivery across Agile Release Trains (ARTs) through ART ceremonies (PI Planning, ART Sync, PO Sync, System Demo) 
Use data analysis and modelling to uncover insights and support decision-making 

AI Enablement and PM Innovation

Actively use AI tools to accelerate program work — status reporting, risk synthesis, documentation, meeting prep, and more
Able to evaluate practical opportunities and apply lightweight AI-powered solutions to day to day program management workflows without requiring engineering support
Help scale program management bandwidth by mentoring and enabling other PMs and teams to leverage AI effectively
Stay current on relevant AI and other tooling improvements and share what's working with the broader TPM community
Define and document PM standards, templates, and processes that others can use and build on

Experience

12+ years of technical program or project management experience with a demonstrated track record leading and driving large, enterprise-wide transformations and complex programs with multiple teams and external dependencies
Demonstrated crisp, executive level communication is a must
Previous data center experience highly preferred
Specific exposure to following in an enterprise environment is highly desirable
Engineering excellence domains: SRE, developer experience, building and scaling engineering platforms, DevSecOps, software quality management practices
Data center operations domains: Energy and sustainability, design and construction, digital twins, infrastructure monitoring, capacity planning
Skilled at navigating ambiguity and driving clarity in complex, matrixed environments
Excellent communicator (both written and verbal) and collaborator with a practical, outcomes-driven mindset that appeals to both technical and non-technical audiences
Practical, hands-on experience with tools such as Miro, Jira, Confluence, MS 365 suite, Smartsheet, or equivalent

Education and Certifications

Bachelor's or Master’s degree in a STEM, Computer science, other technical or related fields
One or more relevant certifications required: PMP, PgMP, PMI-ACP, CSM, SAFe RTE, SAFe Program Consultant, or equivalent
Additional certifications in AI/ML fundamentals or digital transformation are a plus

jobs.description:
Stimulus Technologies – Broadband Division

About Us

Stimulus Technologies is a leader in technology services dedicated to bridging the digital divide in underserved communities. With operations across California, Missouri, Nevada, New Mexico, and Oregon, we deliver high-speed, reliable connectivity that transforms lives and businesses. We are a turnkey technology company providing Managed IT Services, VoIP, Cybersecurity, and high-speed Wireless Internet and fiber through Stimulus Broadband.

Position Overview

The Technical Program Manager runs the network and systems programs for Stimulus Broadband outside the fiber build: integration of existing markets onto standard platforms, integration of acquired companies, and wireless network projects. The role owns schedule, cost, scope, risk and project gates for this portfolio and coordinates with the fiber deployment organization where they two depend on each other. The Technical Program Manager reports to the CTO.

What You'll Be Doing

Own the portfolio and master schedule for network and systems integration programs.
Market network integration program: migrate each market onto the target architecture and standard platforms, including cutover planning, subscriber migration and retiring legacy systems.
Run acquisition integration from diligence through cutover and decommissioning.
Manage wireless projects (sector augments, backhaul upgrades, site remediation) from scope through delivery, using contractors and field crews.
Track the NMS/OSS deployment roadmap by market and keep platform, network and operations sequenced.
Own program budgets and forecasts with finance.
Run project gates and coordinate release to production with Network Operations.
Maintain the project's intake queue and prioritization.
Hold vendors and contractors to scope, schedule, and quality.
Own the risk register and drive escalations to closure.
Coordinate dependencies with the fiber build organization.
Report status to the CTO, CEO, and finance.
Travel to markets as business needs require.

Success Profile

Organized leader with can do attitude and able to work across a wide variety of functions
Holds vendors and internal teams to dates and scope.
Systems thinking and technical enough to challenge engineers and contractors.
Writes status an executive can act on quickly.

Required Skills & Qualifications

8+ years in technical program management on network, systems or infrastructure programs, preferably at an ISP, carrier or MSP.
Experience running migrations and cutovers on live networks with active subscribers.
Scheduling, critical path, program controls, forecasting, and change control.
Stage-gate governance and vendor and contractor management.
Working knowledge of fixed wireless, IP networking, NMS/OSS/BSS platforms, and fiber access.
ISP business knowledge: take rate, churn, cost per subscriber and payback.
Preferred: acquisition integration at an ISP or carrier; NMS/OSS platform deployments; wireless capital programs; hands-on engineering background.
Must reside in Nevada, California, Oregon, Missouri or New Mexico. Adjacent states may be considered for the right candidate.

Physical Requirements

Extended periods working at a computer.
Regular travel among markets for cutovers, project reviews and contractor oversight.
Occasional lifting of equipment or materials up to 25 pounds.
Site visits to data centers, tower sites and active project sites.

Requirements

Stimulus Technologies conducts pre-employment and random background checks, along with drug, alcohol, and cannabis testing. Candidates must pass all required screenings.
A valid driver's license and an acceptable driving record are required.

Alignment with Core Values

At Stimulus Technologies, our core values define how we work. The ideal candidate will demonstrate:

Driven to Grow – Continuously seeks to develop professionally, stays current with industry practices, and pushes to improve processes and outcomes.
See a Need – Fill a Need – Proactively identifies gaps, obstacles, or opportunities and acts without waiting to be asked.
Elevate Others – Mentors teammates, shares knowledge freely, and actively contributes to a positive and collaborative work environment.
Extreme Ownership – Takes full accountability for results, decisions, and mistakes; does not deflect blame or make excuses.
Celebrate Success – Recognizes contributions of team members, acknowledges milestones, and fosters a culture where wins are shared.

Probst Electric specializes in high-voltage transmission line construction, design-build, and maintenance services for public and private sector utilities. Our construction specialties include transmission, distribution, drilling, underground, and renewables.

Probst Electric offers competitive wages and a comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, vision, and 401k. We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and participate in E-Verify.

Probst Electric is seeking an experienced Substation Project Manager
who will lead the planning, direction, and coordination of high-voltage electric transmission and distribution of construction and maintenance projects. Lead pre-construction efforts, including bid preparation, contract and exhibit review, and execution planning.
Develop and manage budget projections for labor, material, equipment, and subcontractors, keeping costs within the forecasted range and implementing cost-saving measures where possible.
Develop and oversee the project Schedule of Values (SOV), update it based on production, prepare billing packages, and submit them to the customer.
Own daily, weekly, and monthly projections and progress reporting for all construction activities.
Provide cost forecasting and monthly cost-to-complete and ensure reporting accuracy.
Develop, submit, track, and maintain all project submittals and requests for information.

POSITION SUMMARY

Talent Table is seeking an experienced IT Project Manager to support technology modernization initiatives for a public-sector client in San Francisco. The Project Manager will lead assigned projects from initiation through implementation and operational transition, managing scope, schedules, budgets, risks, and stakeholder communications.
Projects may include infrastructure, applications, network and voice modernization, cybersecurity, and related information systems. The role works closely with PMO leadership, business partners, technical teams, and vendors.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

1. Project Planning & Delivery
• Lead IT projects through initiation, planning, execution, monitoring, deployment, and transition.

jobs.title: Senior Operations Analyst for Undersea Warfare
jobs.description:
Description

Do you have experience investigating and solving complex issues, and conveying analysis to a variety of audiences?

Are you interested in applying your skills to critical problems supporting national security?

If so, we 're looking for someone like you to join our team at APL.

We are seeking an experienced operations analyst to provide technical contributions and leadership to support continued American all-domain and joint warfare superiority. We are a hardworking team of analysts and operators who apply the latest technology to important problems supporting the US Navy Sea Control Mission. Our group strives to cultivate an environment of innovation and collaboration while working on complex technical challenges that contribute to the security of the United States!

As a Senior Operations Analyst for Undersea Warfare...

Your primary responsibility will be to analyze and evaluate Concepts of Operations (CONOPs) of Surface Warfare (SUW), Undersea Warfare (USW) and Anti-Submarine Warfare (ASW) platforms and sensors.
You will provide technical contributions in the form of problem definition, requirements and metrics development, system assessment, analysis of mission success, and documentation.
You will work with analysis team and systems authorities to evaluate and assess measures of performance and measures of effectiveness for SUW, USW and ASW systems.
You will conduct evaluation of factors such as system performance, logistic requirements, costs, operational impacts, and potential CONOPs, the results of which will be detailed in reports and annotated briefs for delivery to Department of War (DoW) sponsors.
You will interact with DoW and or Navy staff to facilitate task execution and work prioritization. This includes briefing the sponsor or DoW command staff on the insights of the work and possible participation in field tests or sea trials for SUW, USW or ASW platforms and sensors.

Qualifications

You meet our minimum qualifications for the job if you...

Have a Bachelor 's Degree with ten or more years of relevant USW/ASW operational/technical experience.
Are technically and analytically oriented and possess curiosity about both current and future SUW/USW/ASW systems and work well in a team environment with a proven ability to lead small teams.
Have initiative, motivation and flexibility, and possess strong analytical, operational, problem-solving and organizational skills.
Are willing and able to travel (i.e., occasional 2-3 day trips or week long tests), are willing to work on dynamic projects, and can prioritize a number of concurrent taskings.
Hold an active Secret security clearance and can ultimately obtain a TS/SCI level clearance. If selected, you will be subject to a government security clearance investigation and must meet the requirements for access to classified information. Eligibility requirements include U.S. citizenship.

You 'll go above and beyond our minimum requirements if you...

Have a Master's degree in Engineering, Physics, Applied Mathematics, Operations Research or relevant technical field.
Have held Commander Command, Major Command and/or sequential Command responsibilities.
Have worked under a Combatant Command Staff and have understanding of Operational Planning and battle management command and control and joint planning processes, procedures and functions.
Have experience working on Navy or Joint staffs and have familiarity with acquisition processes.
Have demonstrated understanding of features and patterns in data that identify the characteristics and behaviors of systems or components.
Have a current Top Secret or higher level security clearance.
Possess a good understanding of potential adversary defensive and offensive capabilities.

The Johns Hopkins University Applied Physics Laboratory (APL) brings world-class expertise to our nation’s most critical defense, security, space and science challenges. Our employees enjoy generous benefits, including a robust education assistance program, unparalleled retirement contributions, and a healthy work/life balance. The role

As a Security Operations Analyst you will be part of a small team that is responsible for monitoring and maintaining the security of Gateley's IT infrastructure, software, and users.

The Security Operations Analyst Will

Be responsible for the day-to-day operation and maintenance of security tools and controls.
Proactively monitor the firm's network and computing infrastructure, review reports and respond to threat intelligence and alerts.
Raise and manage incidents and changes, remediate vulnerabilities, and implement improvements in IT Security.
Prepare and present routine reporting of agreed security KPIs and of compliance with policy and security certifications.
Work with other members of the IT Team and the wider business as 2nd line support where IT Security input is required for BAU or project activities.
Conduct simulated phishing tests and manage delivery of online security training and awareness campaigns.
Maintain and develop your knowledge of IT Security, industry trends, technology, and threats.
Assist third-party providers of security services with penetration testing and security auditing and certification.
Contribute knowledge and expertise in relation to the secure design of new services.

Identify opportunities for improvement.
Ensure that all system and operating documentation is up to date and available to the appropriate teams.

The team

Gateley Plc has a dynamic and collaborative IT department. We are growing our team to 55 staff members in total across IT Service, Infrastructure, Architecture, Security, Change Management, Development, Innovation and Client Solutions.

The Information Security Team is responsible for monitoring the Gateley network for suspicious activity, identifying vulnerabilities, responding to security incidents, and collaborating with IT and the wider business to reduce risk and improve security controls.

In a constantly changing and evolving IT environment, you’ll use a collection of security tools to measure and maintain our compliance with policies, standards, and external certifications such as Cyber Essentials Plus.

The person

We are looking for someone with a broad knowledge of IT and some IT Security experience, ready to take on responsibility for our day-to-day security operations. We will provide training and other opportunities for the right person to develop their skills.

Essential

A practical understanding of information security in a corporate environment
Security monitoring, alert triage and incident response principles
Networking concepts, services and protocols, including LAN, WAN, DNS, encryption and remote access
Identity and access management, multifactor authentication and privileged access
Microsoft Windows desktop and server operating systems
Microsoft 365, Microsoft Entra ID, Active Directory
Endpoint, email, network, web, and cloud security technologies
Vulnerability management and remediation
IT service management principles, including incident and change management
Excellent documentation and communication skills

Understanding of AI technology and associated security risks
Familiarity with standards, controls, certifications including ISO 27001, Cyber Essentials Plus
Understanding of statutory and regulatory requirements for the handling of sensitive data
Experience of working within the legal/professional services industry
Business continuity planning and disaster recovery
Microsoft Azure, Intune, Configuration Manager
Virtualisation, Linux, scripting or software development
Security testing experience

About You

About Us

The benefits

With support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around our great development and progression opportunities will reward your commitment and loyalty. We offer a competitive remuneration package where you'll be rewarded for your individual performance with an opportunity to receive an annual bonus.

In addition, we have a wide range of learning and development opportunities via our Learn platform to develop new skills and progress your career. Our My Flex comprehensive rewards package includes options covering annual leave (and the benefit of purchasing extra days), cycle to work, critical illness benefit, employee assistance programme, group personal pension, health care, season ticket loan and many more benefits (grade dependent). Finally, with Perks At Work/Home you can select a host of retail benefits that suit your needs alongside a Community Online Academy, free courses for all from fitness to coding to languages to hip hop dance.

We are Gateley

We are forward thinking and straight talking, our approach is to find solutions to the problems that our clients face. Gateley is a legal and professional services group, we are a group of formidable experts in all areas of law and business. Passionate problem solvers, we get our kicks from finding the right answers and getting our legal and business clients where they need to be. We support more than 5,700 active clients, ranging from FTSE 100 companies to private individuals, in the UK and beyond. Being part of Gateley is not just about the expertise that you bring; it's about attitude too.

The 'Gateley Story' is the story of our people and our culture. It is what has got us to where we are today as a successful business and it's the driving force behind the Gateley Team Spirit and the values that have shaped it. We have a set of shared internal values that capture what the Gateley Team Spirit is and this includes five elements that bind us all together as one Gateley: Ambitious for Success, Forward Thinking, Room to Breathe, Trusted to Do and Working Together. Every year across the group, we recognise members of our team that have gone and above and beyond and have lived these shared values. They are recognised at our annual Gateley Team Spirit awards.

and well being

Diversity, inclusion and well being is an important part of Gateley's culture and values. We recruit talented people from a diverse range of backgrounds and cultures, providing equal opportunities for all to join our team regardless of age, sex, race, sexual orientation, disability, or culture.

We create an exciting and rewarding place to work that aims to fulfil everyone's potential and together to achieve personal and business goals. We offer flexible working patterns to help our staff achieve a good work/ life balance and we encourage candidates seeking flexibility in their next role t­o apply for any of our vacancies.

We are proud to have been recognised by The Law Society as gold standard for our Diversity and Inclusion Charter and to be Stonewall Diversity Champions.

Description

Business Operations Analyst, Public Health Laboratories

This position offers a hybrid work arrangement, combining remote work with scheduled onsite work at our DOH facility in Shoreline, WA, approximately 1-2 days week.

This Non-Permanent Appointment has a duration of 6 months.

The Opportunity

As the Business Operations Analyst, you will manage and improve the business processes that keep Washington State Public Health Laboratories (PHL) operating efficiently. This position oversees laboratory invoicing and payment coordination, facilitates procurement and contract activities, maintains equipment and asset tracking processes, and provides operational information to support laboratory management. You will work closely with laboratory staff, management, vendors, and DOH procurement and accounting teams to resolve issues, maintain accurate records, and ensure purchasing and payment activities move forward. You will also identify opportunities to improve administrative workflows, lead continuous improvement projects, and develop practical tools and procedures that strengthen how PHL manages its business operations.

Key Responsibilities Include

Manage the PHL invoicing process, including reviewing and organizing purchase orders, invoices, and proof-of-delivery documentation, coordinating payment processing, and resolving vendor payment issues.
Coordinate with vendors, DOH Procurement, Accounting, and laboratory staff to obtain required documentation, address payment barriers, and maintain accurate vendor payment information.
Facilitate contract and grant activities by guiding staff through contract initiation and renewal processes, maintaining tracking records, and providing purchasing and asset information to support grant development.
Coordinate procurement activities between laboratory staff and DOH Procurement to meet laboratory supply and service needs.

Lead continuous process improvement efforts by identifying administrative inefficiencies, developing solutions, and coordinating implementation through the PHL Continuous Process Improvement forum.

Where Science Protects Communities

At the Public Health Laboratories, every test matters. We’re the state’s reference lab, tracking rare threats like rabies, hantavirus, and West Nile virus, analyzing outbreaks, and safeguarding food and water safety.
