jobs.description:
Flex is transforming the fragmented $90B+ moving, storage, and last-mile delivery industry into a seamless, technology-driven experience. Our two-sided marketplace connects customers with a nationwide network of independent drivers and movers.

As Program Manager, Marketplace Quality
, you will own the programs that drive provider quality, reliability, and performance across Flex's marketplace. You'll get into the field to understand our services firsthand, establish quality standards across reliability, customer ratings, and job execution, and build scalable programs that ensure providers are qualified, trained, and incentivized to deliver exceptional customer experiences.

This role requires strong technical and analytical acumen
to partner closely with Product, Engineering, Data, and Operations to design and implement algorithmic quality management systems, gamification, provider scoring, and automated performance programs
. You'll help shape how provider performance influences ratings, incentives, earnings opportunities, badges, and job prioritization, creating a marketplace where high-quality service is consistently rewarded and underperformance is addressed at scale.

This role is open to USA remote, with need-based travel to our offices and operating markets. Applicants must be authorized to work full-time in the US without visa sponsorship.

Core Responsibilities

Marketplace Quality & Reliability:
Develop measurable quality standards across service execution, on-time arrivals, fulfillment, cancellations, no-shows, and customer satisfaction.
Field Quality & Service Standards:
Spend time in the field understanding Flex's services, evaluating job execution, identifying quality gaps, and translating insights into network-wide standards.
Scoring & Gamification:
Design provider scoring systems, performance tiers, badges, rewards, and incentive programs that link quality and reliability to earnings opportunities and job prioritization.
Algorithmic Quality Management:
Partner with Product and Engineering to develop automated performance monitoring, quality-based matching, accountability mechanisms, eligibility controls, and remediation workflows.
Training & Qualifications:
Own provider training, certifications, qualification standards, and ongoing eligibility requirements.
Performance Management:
Build scalable quality audits, performance monitoring, and improvement programs that reward strong performance and address recurring service failures.
Cross-Functional Execution:
Partner with Product, Engineering, Data, and Operations to translate quality strategies into scalable technology solutions and measurable outcomes.

Key Requirements

Marketplace Experience:
4+ years in marketplace operations, supply quality, or program management, with direct experience designing and managing quality programs within a gig economy or two-sided marketplace.
Quality Systems:
Proven experience developing provider scoring, ratings, gamification, incentive, or automated performance management programs.
Technical & Analytical Acumen:
Strong ability to work with data, define scoring logic and automated decision frameworks, and translate operational requirements into technical specifications alongside Product and Engineering.
Operational Understanding:
Ability to evaluate frontline service delivery, identify root causes of quality issues, and translate field observations into scalable operational standards.
Marketplace Dynamics:
Deep understanding of provider reliability, supply engagement, retention, and quality enforcement trade-offs.
Program Leadership:
Proven ability to independently design, launch, and scale cross-functional programs in a fast-paced environment.

What Success Looks Like

You'll start by getting into the field, experiencing Flex's moving and storage services firsthand, and understanding what drives exceptional service across our driver and mover network. You'll translate those insights into clear, measurable quality standards
across provider reliability, customer ratings, and job execution.

Working with Product, Engineering, Data, and Operations, you'll build a scalable, algorithmic quality management program
that uses gamification, scoring, incentives, and automated interventions to influence provider behavior.

Ultimately, you'll create a system where provider quality directly influences ratings, rewards, earnings opportunities, badges, and job prioritization
, consistently rewarding high performers and addressing underperformance.

Success means building a self-reinforcing marketplace where quality drives opportunity, providers are motivated to deliver exceptional service, and network-wide performance improves as Flex scales without proportional increases in manual oversight.

jobs.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Project Manager based in France.

As Project Manager, you will play an essential role in coordinating and supporting the delivery of professional security services for blockchain and decentralised finance (DeFi) projects. You will work closely with client engagement teams and technical security specialists, ensuring that projects progress smoothly from initial kickoff through final delivery. Your responsibilities will include managing project tasks, coordinating meetings, tracking action items and maintaining clear communication between stakeholders. You will help minimise administrative workloads for engineers, allowing them to focus on delivering high-quality security solutions. Working in a fully remote, international and technically driven environment, you will contribute to building trusted client relationships and ensuring operational excellence. This is an excellent opportunity to develop your project management expertise while gaining exposure to cybersecurity, blockchain technology and complex technical engagements.

Accountabilities

Support the coordination and execution of client security engagements, taking ownership of assigned tasks and ensuring activities are completed according to established processes and instructions.
Maintain accurate and up-to-date project task trackers, ensuring that delivery teams and leadership have clear visibility into progress, priorities, deadlines and outstanding actions.
Attend internal and client meetings, document key discussions, capture decisions and create clear action items with assigned owners and deadlines.
Proactively follow up on outstanding tasks and action items, ensuring that commitments are tracked and completed within agreed timelines.
Monitor client communication channels, particularly Slack, identifying questions, emerging risks, delivery blockers and potential signs of reduced customer engagement.
Reduce administrative workloads for security engineers by coordinating meetings, tracking access requests and ensuring customer requirements are properly documented and ready for action.
Assist in preparing regular project status reports and updates for leadership, clients and relevant stakeholders.
Participate in customer meetings to develop an understanding of client relationship management, stakeholder communication and trust-building practices.
Learn, understand and consistently apply internal policies, project management tools, operational procedures and service delivery standards.
Identify opportunities to improve coordination, communication and administrative processes to support efficient project execution.

Requirements

Between 1 and 3 years of experience in project coordination, project management, operations or a similar position within a technical or professional services environment. Internships and co-op experience are also considered.
Excellent organisational skills and attention to detail, with the ability to manage multiple tasks, track outstanding actions and ensure that nothing is overlooked.
Strong written communication skills, particularly in preparing accurate meeting notes, documenting decisions and producing clear, concise project updates.
Proactive communication habits, including regularly sharing progress, anticipating potential issues, asking relevant questions and seeking support when facing blockers.
Strong interpersonal and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively with engineers, project stakeholders and client-facing teams.
Coachable mindset and willingness to actively seek feedback, learn from colleagues and continuously improve professional performance.
Genuine curiosity about cybersecurity and an interest in understanding how complex technical security projects and programmes are delivered.
Ability to work independently, manage priorities and remain organised in a fully remote and distributed working environment.

Nice to have: Familiarity with project management and collaboration platforms, task-tracking systems and communication tools.
Nice to have: Previous exposure to customer-facing responsibilities, client coordination or stakeholder support.
Nice to have: Academic or professional background in Computer Science, Software Development, Cybersecurity or another technical discipline.
Nice to have: Familiarity with blockchain technology, Layer 1 and Layer 2 networks, decentralised finance (DeFi) or related ecosystems.

jobs.description:
Supply Chain Data Analyst

W2 Contract 3+ Months

San Francisco, CA 94108

$50–$60/hour

About the Opportunity

Tatcha is seeking a detail-oriented and analytical Supply Chain Planning Analyst to support its Supply Chain Planning team on a temporary assignment. This is an excellent opportunity for a data-driven professional who enjoys solving problems, improving data accuracy, and keeping supply chain operations running smoothly.

In this role, you'll work extensively in NetSuite and Excel to maintain critical inventory and planning data, troubleshoot discrepancies, and support reporting, product launches, and inventory management. The ideal candidate is highly organized, comfortable navigating complex datasets, and confident working independently to identify and resolve issues.

What You'll Do

NetSuite & Data Management

Execute mass updates and CSV imports in NetSuite, including item records, vendor information, and planning parameters.
Validate data before and after system updates to ensure accuracy and maintain detailed change logs.
Identify and correct outdated, duplicate, or inconsistent master data, including obsolete BOMs and inactive items.

Inventory & Supply Chain Support

Support inventory tracking and approvals for samples, gift-with-purchase items, and other complimentary products.
Monitor inventory levels against promotional program requirements, identifying potential shortages or excess.
Assist with product kits and sets by verifying bills of materials (BOMs), tracking component availability, and monitoring production timelines.
Support inventory and item data management for Tatcha.com, including product availability and channel allocations.
Reconcile ecommerce inventory and order data against NetSuite records, investigating and resolving discrepancies.

Reporting & Process Improvement

Generate and maintain recurring NetSuite reports and saved searches.
Analyze data and respond to reporting requests from the supply planning team.
Investigate data inconsistencies, document root causes, and help prevent recurring errors.
Communicate potential inventory or data issues proactively to support effective planning decisions.

What We're Looking For

4+ years of experience in supply chain, inventory management, operations analytics, or related data-focused roles.
Hands-on NetSuite experience, specifically with saved searches, mass updates, and CSV imports.
Strong Excel proficiency, including lookups, pivot tables, and working with large datasets.
Familiarity with bills of materials (BOMs), item master records, and inventory transactions.
Exceptional attention to detail and a commitment to data accuracy.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to independently investigate discrepancies.
Excellent organization and communication skills, including the ability to identify issues early and keep stakeholders informed.

Nice to Have

Experience in beauty, skincare, consumer packaged goods (CPG), or related industries.
Familiarity with product kitting, gift-with-purchase programs, or promotional inventory.
Experience supporting direct-to-consumer (DTC) ecommerce operations.

Join our regional Operational Excellence Engineering Digital team and play a key role in accelerating digital transformation across our manufacturing network in EMEA & APAC.

Our team owns and develops the shared regional platform connecting machine data, orchestration, analytics and business systems, providing manufacturing sites with the standards and capabilities they need to turn digital solutions into tangible operational improvements.

At the City of Leduc, our mission is Building a connected community for all people. We offer a collaborative and dynamic workplace where our values of Teamwork, Service, Respect and Leadership guide our conduct and contribute to a healthy culture. If you would like to work as part of a progressive organization and enjoy a fast-paced environment, then this may be the opportunity for you.

Come work with us!

At the City of Leduc, environmental stewardship is more than a strategy, it's a shared commitment. Our Environment team is a close-knit, collaborative group that works together to deliver meaningful projects that support a sustainable, resilient, and thriving community.

We're looking for more than a technical expert. We're looking for someone who values teamwork, enjoys building strong relationships, and takes pride in helping others succeed. Our team shares knowledge freely, supports one another's projects, and works together to solve complex challenges. Success in this role comes from a combination of technical expertise, leadership, accountability, and a genuine commitment to collaboration.

As our next Environmental Project Manager, you'll play a central role in advancing the City's environmental priorities. From climate readiness and waste reduction initiatives to contaminated site management and environmental planning, your work will directly influence how our community grows and adapts for years to come.

What is the Opportunity?

Reporting to the Manager, Environment, the Environmental Project Manager is responsible for leading the implementation of key environmental initiatives that support the City's long-term sustainability goals. This includes advancing priorities related to waste reduction, climate adaptation, water conservation, integrated pest management, contaminated sites, and environmental monitoring.

This role requires a balance of technical knowledge, project management, and relationship-building. You will work closely with colleagues across Engineering, Planning, Public Services, and other departments while also collaborating with businesses, residents, consultants, regulatory agencies, and regional partners. Your ability to build trust, influence stakeholders, and move projects forward will be just as important as your technical expertise.

As a key environmental leader within the organization, you will help turn approved plans into measurable results while providing sound environmental advice, supporting informed decision-making, and contributing to a stronger future for the City of Leduc.

What will you do?

In This Diverse And Impactful Role, You Will

Lead the implementation of environmental initiatives that support the City's Environmental Plan, Greenhouse Gas Reduction Plan, Weather & Climate Readiness Plan, and other sustainability strategies.
Work directly with businesses, property managers, condominium boards, and waste service providers to advance waste diversion and waste reduction programs throughout the community.
Coordinate environmental site assessments, groundwater monitoring programs, contaminated site investigations, and remediation projects for municipal properties.
Support environmental planning by reviewing biophysical assessments, area structure plans, and subdivision applications while providing recommendations to internal stakeholders.
Oversee the Leduc Environmental Advisory Board by attending meetings and overseeing all projects
Collaborate with Engineering and operational departments to implement initiatives related to climate adaptation, stormwater resilience, integrated pest management, water conservation, invasive species prevention, and salt management.
Represent the City of Leduc at regional committees, stakeholder groups, working groups, and industry meetings focused on environmental sustainability and best practices.
Manage environmental consulting projects, including project scoping, procurement processes, consultant selection, contract administration, and technical review of deliverables.
Research funding opportunities and assist with grant applications that support environmental initiatives and long-term sustainability objectives.
Provide leadership, mentorship, and technical guidance to the Environmental Inspector while fostering a collaborative and supportive team environment.

Who you are?

Benefits

You enjoy bringing people together, navigating competing priorities, and helping teams achieve shared goals. You are accountable, approachable, and committed to delivering high-quality work that benefits both the organization and the community. You bring:

A Bachelor of Science, Environmental degree, or technical Environmental diploma from a recognized institution.
A minimum of five (5) years of experience in environmental, municipal, engineering, consulting, or infrastructure-related project work.
A minimum of two (2) years of project management experience coordinating multiple stakeholders, priorities, budgets, and timelines.
Experience working with environmental programs, sustainability initiatives, contaminated site management, climate resilience, waste reduction, or related environmental disciplines.
Exceptional communication and presentation skills, with the ability to engage effectively with residents, consultants, businesses, contractors, leadership teams, and partner organizations.
Strong report-writing, research, and analytical skills, allowing you to develop practical recommendations and communicate complex information clearly.
Experience working with consultants and preparing requests for proposals
A collaborative mindset and a genuine willingness to support teammates, mentor others, share knowledge, and contribute to overall team success.
The ability to build strong relationships, navigate challenging conversations professionally, and earn the trust of diverse stakeholders.
Sound judgment, strong accountability, and a demonstrated commitment to following through on commitments and delivering results.

Experience with municipal environmental programs, environmental regulations, GIS, AutoCAD, water modelling software, sanitary sewer modelling software, or grant funding programs would be considered assets.

What we Offer?

Role

Joining the Engineering team at the City of Leduc means becoming part of a supportive and collaborative environment where your expertise is valued and your contributions make a visible impact on the community. In this role, we offer:

A rewarding portfolio of work where you can see the tangible results of your environmental strategies across the community.
A workplace culture that prioritizes work-life balance through flexible thinking, respectful collaboration, and a focus on sustainable workloads.

Reporting to the L&D Manager, this role independently leads assigned talent development programs from design through implementation, measurement, and continuous improvement. Working with business leaders, HR partners, and external partners, you will assess needs, identify root causes and opportunities, recommend solutions, and make informed program-level decisions that balance business needs, stakeholder input, risks, and available resources.

What You Will Do

Employee and Leadership Development

Leads the design, implementation, and continuous improvement of assigned employee and leadership development programs. Working within enterprise L&D priorities and in partnership with Talent and Business Leaders, this role translates organizational needs into practical solutions, learning experiences, and resources that build capability and support business objectives. Serves as both a program leader and facilitator, bringing strategic thinking and strong execution to the programs and initiatives within its scope.

Partners with L&D leadership, Talent partners, Business leaders, and key stakeholders to diagnose current and future capability needs, identify gaps and root causes, and recommend solutions aligned with business needs and enterprise L&D priorities.
Independently leads assigned employee and leadership development programs from design through execution and continuous improvement, establishing clear plans, milestones, stakeholder responsibilities, dependencies, and measures of success. Proactively identifies and addresses risks, gaps, and downstream impacts throughout the lifecycle of the work.
Translates enterprise development priorities into effective program strategies, content, curricula, learning experiences, and supporting resources, determining the appropriate approach based on the business and participant needs.
Establishes sustainment strategies, success measures, and feedback mechanisms to evaluate program effectiveness and business impact, using insights to continuously improve program design and outcomes.
Partners with internal stakeholders and vendors to design, customize, and deliver learning solutions that address identified business and capability needs and complement Ulteig's broader development offerings.
Exercises sound, independent judgment in program-level decisions, balancing business needs, stakeholder input, risks, available resources, and established priorities; appropriately escalates decisions with broader strategic, portfolio, or resource implications.
Adheres to facilitation and adult learning best practices to ensure impactful learning experiences and retention of material by participants.
Trains other facilitators on best practices and ensures regular evaluation of all facilitated content for continuous improvement.
Supports organizational change initiatives by designing and delivering learning, engagement, and upskilling solutions.
Establishes and maintains program standards, processes, and resources that drive quality, consistency, scalability, and continuous improvement, ensuring deliverables are accurate, complete, well considered, and ready for stakeholder review.
Independently manage complex, cross-functional initiatives with clear plans, milestones, dependencies, stakeholder responsibilities, and follow-through.

Mentoring Programs

Leads the design, management, and continuous improvement of Ulteig’s mentoring programs to support employee and leader development.

Develops and maintains mentoring resources and processes, including an effective approach for matching mentee learning objectives/needs with potential mentors.
Evaluates when mentoring is the appropriate talent solution and recommends blended or alternative learning approaches based on the business and employee needs.
Works with HR Business Partners to help facilitate mentoring matches.

Integrated Employee Development

Partners with internal stakeholders and HR colleagues to connect learning and development with broader talent programs and business needs, including Career Development Plans, succession planning, employee survey feedback, strategic initiatives, goal setting, and performance reviews. Proactively identifies opportunities to integrate learning and development solutions with broader talent processes and business needs, recommending approaches that strengthen alignment and impact.

Evaluates and prioritizes learning requests based on business needs, organizational impact, available capacity, and established L&D priorities.
Effectively manages time, competing priorities, and commitments to ensure agreed-upon deliverables and timelines are met.
Supports offsite planning and execution with learning content as applicable.
May support additional programs or duties, as assigned.

What We Expect From You

Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Organizational Development or related field, or equivalent experience
5+ years of experience leading the design, development, and management of talent development programs, or related experience that provides equivalent knowledge is required, with 7+ years of experience preferred
Strong understanding of leading practices and innovations in talent management
Demonstrated ability to independently lead complex, cross-functional programs and projects from planning through execution, including stakeholder alignment, project planning, risk management, decision-making, follow-through, and measurement of outcomes.
Confidence and demonstrated ability to facilitate engaging virtual and in-person learning experiences for audiences ranging from individual contributors to senior leaders.
Strong strategic thinking, analytical, and problem-solving skills, with a demonstrated ability to diagnose needs, identify root causes, evaluate options, and recommend solutions aligned with business objectives.
Understanding of adult learning principles and creative training development approaches
Ability to travel 25%
Excellent verbal and written communication skills
Strong program and project management skills, with demonstrated ability to prioritize competing needs, anticipate risks and dependencies, maintain attention to detail, and deliver high-quality work with limited direction.
Demonstrated initiative and ability to operate independently within the scope of the role, proactively addressing issues and recognizing when broader strategic, portfolio, or resource decisions require input or escalation.
Proficient with Microsoft Office Suite or related software
Demonstrates openness to innovation by embracing and applying evolving technology and AI tools to enhance workflows, solve problems, and drive continuous improvement
Must have authorization to work permanently in the U.S.

Amazon Catalog Services builds the systems that host and run the world’s largest e-Commerce catalog. Within this organization, Product Knowledge (PK) is responsible for mining, modeling, storing and vending the product catalog metadata. This metadata (schema) governs all the possible product information and powers Amazon end-to-end processes, starting on how we organize products, how we define all possible product attributes, how we guide selling partners when listing them, all the way to power customer shopping experiences (e.g., product overview in detail pages, browse taxonomy, search and navigation filters). If you've ever shopped on Amazon, you interacted with our product.

We are investing in an initiative to help scale different Amazon Businesses. This includes performing agentic orchestration replicating system and manual decisions across Catalog components. These investments will encompass aligning stakeholders on a strategy, driving workstreams across platform infrastructure, agent creation, orchestration, enabling products across Catalog, Listings, SX, CX and measurements of impact. We are hiring a Principal Technical Program Manager (PTPM) for this charter in Seattle to lead the initiative.

As a Principal TPM in this role, you will collaborate closely with leaders, managers, engineers and scientists to deliver solutions into production, establish partnerships with other organizations such as Retail, Category businesses, Selling Partner Services, Detail Page CX, Search, to prioritize and translate the business requirements into technical specifications. You will have end to end ownership - from defining the strategy, working across engineering teams to build the solution, and monitoring progress across the entire Amazon eCommerce pipeline. You will provide direct visibility to senior leadership on all aspects of your programs, drive cross team collaboration, and prioritize initiatives that are crucial to businesses.

Key job responsibilities

Define and deliver large-scale, cross-organizational programs by establishing clear goals, managing dependencies, mitigating risks, and driving execution across multiple engineering and business teams.

Drive system-level and business reviews, aligning teams toward coherent technology strategies, effective engineering processes, and long-term operational improvements.

About The Team

The Catalog Services Product Knowledge organization is responsible for building systems that create and manage the e-commerce schema. new_jobs.title: Sr. Technical Program Manager, Network Product Development, Interconnects
new_jobs.description:
Description

AWS builds one of the largest networks in the world, and every rack that lands in a data center depends on optics, copper, fiber and switches all arriving on time. The Network Product Development (NPD) Interconnects team designs and brings to production the optical modules, DAC/AEC copper cables and structured fiber that connect AWS infrastructure.

We are looking for a Senior Technical Program Manager to help drive how our products move from forecast to factory to data center. You will be the day-to-day interface between Supply Chain, our manufacturing vendors and the NPD engineers who design our products. You make sure each group has the technical context, data and decisions it needs from the others. When a forecast changes, a supplier raises a constraint or a build stalls, you bring the right people together quickly, frame the trade-offs clearly and drive the issue to resolution.

We work quickly and practically. Rather than waiting for large software programs, you will use AI tools, agents, scripts and lightweight workflows to stand up working processes fast. You'll run them on a regular cadence with our partners and improve them as you learn. Once a process has proven itself, you will help turn it into durable tooling.

Key job responsibilities

Drive the end-to-end program for interconnect products (optical modules, DAC/AEC, fiber and structured cabling) from forecast to delivery, and report progress and risks to NPD and Networking leadership through a regular business review.
Act as the primary interface between Supply Chain, vendors and NPD engineering. Translate engineering constraints into supply implications and supply constraints into engineering decisions.
Coordinate technical review of significant forecast changes (product mix or volume) with engineering and Supply Chain before they are shared with suppliers.
Help keep long-range capacity commitments and short-range build signals distinct. Raise it early when an execution signal risks undoing a long-lead commitment (DSPs, lasers, PCBs, raw fiber materials, line capacity).
Partner with engineering and Supply Chain to keep BOM and allocation data consistent, so sub-tier requirements line up across commodity managers.
Run scenario analyses (for example a 50% demand increase or decrease) with Supply Chain and engineering to show where commitments break across components and sub-tiers, and help teams agree on the response.
Work with vendors and Supply Chain to track supplier commitments and de-commitments for critical sub-tier parts
Drive a weekly clear-to-build (CTB) review with vendors and Supply Chain that combines component availability against the build plan, escalates shortfalls early and handles excess inventory without stopping the line.
Track capacity KPIs with our vendors. Work with engineering and site teams to validate capacity constraints when the data doesn't line up.
Coordinate with Supply Chain and deployment teams on inventory at VMI hubs and rack integrators, so production plans reflect where finished units can actually go.
Support rack integration improvements with engineering and integrators: rack portfolio standardization, production-readiness validation for new rack designs, first-pass yield, test time and the time from PO to start of assembly.
Use AI tools and agents every day to automate data gathering, reconcile vendor and Supply Chain data, generate status reports and catch issues early.
Build AI-assisted workflows that cut manual spreadsheet work for engineers and Supply Chain partners, and share what works across the team.
Write requirements and work with software teams to turn proven processes and AI-assisted workflows into durable tools.

A day in the life

Your week might start with a CTB review across optics and fiber vendors, where an AI agent you set up has already reconciled the latest vendor data and flagged a laser shortfall weeks ahead. You then pull Supply Chain and engineering together to work through what a forecast revision means for supplier agreements. Later you follow up with a vendor on a capacity constraint that doesn't match their reported output, and join a call with a rack integrator on why a high-volume configuration keeps failing first-pass test. You write clear updates for leadership and turn this week's manual fixes into next week's automated workflow. Expect regular travel between Seattle and the Bay Area, as well as to supplier and integrator sites, mostly in Asia.

About The Team

NPD Interconnects handles product development for the optics, copper and fiber that link AWS networks, from early engineering through NPI and volume production. We work closely with the NPD switch and software teams, Global Supply Management, fabric and deployment teams, and our manufacturing partners worldwide. We value strong partnerships, mechanisms over good intentions, and a "trust, but verify" approach to the data we rely on.

Basic Qualifications

5+ years of technical product or program management experience
7+ years of working directly with engineering teams experience
5+ years of project management disciplines including scope, schedule, budget, quality, along with risk and critical path management experience
Experience managing programs across cross functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules
Bachelor's degree in Operations, Supply Chain Management, Engineering, or another technical field
Experience working with large-scale data mining and reporting tools (i.e. SQL, MS Power Query, Python), or experience delivering forecasting, budgeting, and variance analysis, and data interpretation of results
Experience managing projects across cross functional teams, building sustainable processes and coordinating release schedules
5+ years of experience in hardware supply chain, manufacturing operations, or NPI for electronic, optical, or networking products
Experience working directly with ODMs, JDMs, or contract manufacturers on capacity, CTB, or production ramps

Preferred Qualifications

Experience defining KPI's/SLA's used to drive multi-million dollar businesses and reporting to senior leadership
Master's degree or above in Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Operations, Supply Chain, or Business Administration, or Master's degree or above in engineering, statistics, computer science, operations research, business analytics, information systems or equivalent
Experience communicating and presenting to senior leadership
Experience leveraging AI-powered tools or data analytics platforms to drive quality improvements, root cause analysis, or process optimization
Experience using AI-powered or data-driven scheduling and planning tools to optimize maintenance workflows
Experience with optical transceivers, DSP and laser supply, copper interconnects, or fiber cabling manufacturing
Experience with multi-tier BOMs, allocation, or sub-tier supply visibility for long-lead components
Experience with rack-level integration and test, yield improvement, or design for manufacturability

new_jobs.title: Sr. Technical Program Manager, Network Product Development, Interconnects
new_jobs.description:
Description

AWS builds one of the largest networks in the world, and every rack that lands in a data center depends on optics, copper, fiber and switches all arriving on time. The Network Product Development (NPD) Interconnects team designs and brings to production the optical modules, DAC/AEC copper cables and structured fiber that connect AWS infrastructure.

We are looking for a Senior Technical Program Manager to help drive how our products move from forecast to factory to data center. You will be the day-to-day interface between Supply Chain, our manufacturing vendors and the NPD engineers who design our products. You make sure each group has the technical context, data and decisions it needs from the others. When a forecast changes, a supplier raises a constraint or a build stalls, you bring the right people together quickly, frame the trade-offs clearly and drive the issue to resolution.

We work quickly and practically. Rather than waiting for large software programs, you will use AI tools, agents, scripts and lightweight workflows to stand up working processes fast. You'll run them on a regular cadence with our partners and improve them as you learn. Once a process has proven itself, you will help turn it into durable tooling.

Key job responsibilities

Drive the end-to-end program for interconnect products (optical modules, DAC/AEC, fiber and structured cabling) from forecast to delivery, and report progress and risks to NPD and Networking leadership through a regular business review.
Act as the primary interface between Supply Chain, vendors and NPD engineering. Translate engineering constraints into supply implications and supply constraints into engineering decisions.
Coordinate technical review of significant forecast changes (product mix or volume) with engineering and Supply Chain before they are shared with suppliers.
Help keep long-range capacity commitments and short-range build signals distinct. Raise it early when an execution signal risks undoing a long-lead commitment (DSPs, lasers, PCBs, raw fiber materials, line capacity).
Partner with engineering and Supply Chain to keep BOM and allocation data consistent, so sub-tier requirements line up across commodity managers.
Run scenario analyses (for example a 50% demand increase or decrease) with Supply Chain and engineering to show where commitments break across components and sub-tiers, and help teams agree on the response.
Work with vendors and Supply Chain to track supplier commitments and de-commitments for critical sub-tier parts
Drive a weekly clear-to-build (CTB) review with vendors and Supply Chain that combines component availability against the build plan, escalates shortfalls early and handles excess inventory without stopping the line.
Track capacity KPIs with our vendors. Work with engineering and site teams to validate capacity constraints when the data doesn't line up.
Coordinate with Supply Chain and deployment teams on inventory at VMI hubs and rack integrators, so production plans reflect where finished units can actually go.
Support rack integration improvements with engineering and integrators: rack portfolio standardization, production-readiness validation for new rack designs, first-pass yield, test time and the time from PO to start of assembly.
Use AI tools and agents every day to automate data gathering, reconcile vendor and Supply Chain data, generate status reports and catch issues early.
Build AI-assisted workflows that cut manual spreadsheet work for engineers and Supply Chain partners, and share what works across the team.
Write requirements and work with software teams to turn proven processes and AI-assisted workflows into durable tools.

A day in the life

Your week might start with a CTB review across optics and fiber vendors, where an AI agent you set up has already reconciled the latest vendor data and flagged a laser shortfall weeks ahead. You then pull Supply Chain and engineering together to work through what a forecast revision means for supplier agreements. Later you follow up with a vendor on a capacity constraint that doesn't match their reported output, and join a call with a rack integrator on why a high-volume configuration keeps failing first-pass test. You write clear updates for leadership and turn this week's manual fixes into next week's automated workflow. Expect regular travel between Seattle and the Bay Area, as well as to supplier and integrator sites, mostly in Asia.

About The Team

NPD Interconnects handles product development for the optics, copper and fiber that link AWS networks, from early engineering through NPI and volume production. We work closely with the NPD switch and software teams, Global Supply Management, fabric and deployment teams, and our manufacturing partners worldwide. We value strong partnerships, mechanisms over good intentions, and a "trust, but verify" approach to the data we rely on.

Basic Qualifications

5+ years of technical product or program management experience
7+ years of working directly with engineering teams experience
5+ years of project management disciplines including scope, schedule, budget, quality, along with risk and critical path management experience
Experience managing programs across cross functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules
Bachelor's degree in Operations, Supply Chain Management, Engineering, or another technical field
Experience working with large-scale data mining and reporting tools (i.e. SQL, MS Power Query, Python), or experience delivering forecasting, budgeting, and variance analysis, and data interpretation of results
Experience managing projects across cross functional teams, building sustainable processes and coordinating release schedules
5+ years of experience in hardware supply chain, manufacturing operations, or NPI for electronic, optical, or networking products
Experience working directly with ODMs, JDMs, or contract manufacturers on capacity, CTB, or production ramps

Preferred Qualifications

Experience defining KPI's/SLA's used to drive multi-million dollar businesses and reporting to senior leadership
Master's degree or above in Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Operations, Supply Chain, or Business Administration, or Master's degree or above in engineering, statistics, computer science, operations research, business analytics, information systems or equivalent
Experience communicating and presenting to senior leadership
Experience leveraging AI-powered tools or data analytics platforms to drive quality improvements, root cause analysis, or process optimization
Experience using AI-powered or data-driven scheduling and planning tools to optimize maintenance workflows
Experience with optical transceivers, DSP and laser supply, copper interconnects, or fiber cabling manufacturing
Experience with multi-tier BOMs, allocation, or sub-tier supply visibility for long-lead components
Experience with rack-level integration and test, yield improvement, or design for manufacturability

Interpret and explain plans and contract terms to administrative staff, workers, and clients.

new_jobs.description:
Description

Business Operations Analyst, Public Health Laboratories

This position offers a hybrid work arrangement, combining remote work with scheduled onsite work at our DOH facility in Shoreline, WA, approximately 1-2 days week.

This Non-Permanent Appointment has a duration of 6 months.

The Opportunity

As the Business Operations Analyst, you will manage and improve the business processes that keep Washington State Public Health Laboratories (PHL) operating efficiently. This position oversees laboratory invoicing and payment coordination, facilitates procurement and contract activities, maintains equipment and asset tracking processes, and provides operational information to support laboratory management. You will work closely with laboratory staff, management, vendors, and DOH procurement and accounting teams to resolve issues, maintain accurate records, and ensure purchasing and payment activities move forward. You will also identify opportunities to improve administrative workflows, lead continuous improvement projects, and develop practical tools and procedures that strengthen how PHL manages its business operations.

Key Responsibilities Include

Manage the PHL invoicing process, including reviewing and organizing purchase orders, invoices, and proof-of-delivery documentation, coordinating payment processing, and resolving vendor payment issues.
Coordinate with vendors, DOH Procurement, Accounting, and laboratory staff to obtain required documentation, address payment barriers, and maintain accurate vendor payment information.
Facilitate contract and grant activities by guiding staff through contract initiation and renewal processes, maintaining tracking records, and providing purchasing and asset information to support grant development.
Coordinate procurement activities between laboratory staff and DOH Procurement to meet laboratory supply and service needs.
Develop and maintain procurement resources, instructional materials, and training to help laboratory staff navigate purchasing processes.
Lead continuous process improvement efforts by identifying administrative inefficiencies, developing solutions, and coordinating implementation through the PHL Continuous Process Improvement forum.
Oversee laboratory equipment and asset tracking activities, including monitoring purchases, costs, service contracts, equipment performance, and inventory records.
Develop and maintain standard operating procedures, tracking tools, and administrative processes that improve the accuracy, consistency, and efficiency of PHL business operations.

Why You’ll Love This Role

This role offers the opportunity to make a meaningful impact behind the scenes of Washington’s public health laboratory system. You will work across different areas of laboratory operations, solve practical business challenges, and turn process improvement ideas into changes that make every day work more efficient. Your contributions help ensure laboratory staff have the equipment, supplies, contracts, and resources they need to deliver critical public health services to communities across Washington.

The Ideal Candidate

You are an organized, solutions-oriented professional who enjoys bringing structure to complex administrative processes and finding better ways to get work done. You are comfortable analyzing information, identifying discrepancies, resolving issues, and coordinating with people across different teams and organizations. You communicate clearly, manage competing priorities, and take initiative in improving processes while remaining responsive to the needs of the people who depend on your work. You value collaboration, approach different perspectives with respect, and understand how reliable business operations contribute to the larger public health mission.

Required Qualifications

There are multiple pathways to qualify for this position. You must meet one of the options provided and any additional criteria listed. Experience may have been gained through paid or unpaid activities. Please ensure any relevant experience defined below is outlined in your cover letter, resume, and/or applicant profile.

Option 1:
Four years of experience in business operations, administrative analysis, procurement coordination, accounts payable, contract administration, asset management, or improving administrative processes such as identifying problems or inefficiencies in existing administrative workflows and developing practical solutions to make them more efficient, accurate, and consistent.

Option 2:
A bachelor's degree in business administration, public administration, accounting, finance, operations management, or a related field AND
Two years of experience in business operations, administrative analysis, procurement coordination, accounts payable, contract administration, asset management, or improving administrative processes such as identifying problems or inefficiencies in existing administrative workflows and developing practical solutions to make them more efficient, accurate, and consistent.

And The Following Knowledge, Skills, And Experience

Experience managing administrative workflows that require accurate documentation, recordkeeping, deadline tracking, and issue resolution.
Experience coordinating purchasing, invoicing, procurement, or contract-related activities with internal teams and external vendors.
Proficient in Microsoft Excel for organizing, tracking, and analyzing operational or financial information.
Experience maintaining electronic records, databases, or tracking systems and developing or documenting standard operating procedures.
Skilled in analyzing administrative processes, identifying problems, and implementing improvements to increase efficiency and accuracy.
Ability to review and analyze purchasing, invoice, or operational records to identify discrepancies, resolve issues, and support business decisions.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience in project management including planning, coordinating, and tracking projects, including timelines, tasks, resources, and deliverables.
Training or certification in Lean, Lean Six Sigma, or a related continuous improvement methodology.
Experience preparing invoice documentation and coordinating payment processing, including purchase orders, invoices, and proof-of-delivery records.
Experience troubleshooting vendor payment issues and coordinating with procurement or accounting teams.
Experience maintaining contract, grant, procurement, or equipment tracking systems.
Experience developing procurement guidance, instructional materials, or training for staff.
Experience applying Lean or continuous improvement methods to administrative processes.
Experience with Microsoft SharePoint, Microsoft Dynamics 365, or comparable business management systems.
Experience supporting laboratory operations, scientific organizations, healthcare organizations, or other environments with specialized equipment and supply needs.

Employee Benefits

We want you to have the support and benefits you need to do your best work while building a career that fits your life. As a DOH employee, you’ll have access to a comprehensive benefits package that supports your health, financial well-being, and work-life balance, with resources to support you now and help you plan for the future. Learn more about DOH benefits and what it’s like to work with us by visiting Work@Health
.

The Public Health Laboratories

Where Science Protects Communities

At the Public Health Laboratories, every test matters. From hunting emerging pathogens to ensuring every newborn in the state gets life-saving screenings, your work will drive disease detection, outbreak response, and protect Washington’s most vulnerable. We’re the state’s reference lab, tracking rare threats like rabies, hantavirus, and West Nile virus, analyzing outbreaks, and safeguarding food and water safety. Here, science meets service in a collaborative, equity-driven team committed to real-world impact and public health at scale.

About The Washington State Department Of Health

We're nearly 2,700 professionals across Washington working together to protect and improve community health. Guided by our values of Equity, Innovation, and Engagement, we address health disparities, respond to emerging challenges, and strengthen systems that support resilience.

At DOH, we help reduce barriers, collaborate with diverse communities, and champion equitable health outcomes. We're passionate people who are driven to make a difference in public health
. Our work depends on people who take action to learn and grow and who take action to meet the needs of others every day, in service of a healthier Washington. Explore more about the Department of Health, our programs, and our impact by visiting our website
.

What To Expect (Working Conditions)

The following describes the working conditions of this position, with or without reasonable accommodation.

Work Setting:
This position requires regular onsite work at the Public Health Laboratories in Shoreline, WA, with a hybrid remote/telework schedule determined upon hire. When working remotely, the employee may work from home, a DOH office, or another alternate location where exposure to hazards is limited to those commonly found in an office environment.

The position is primarily sedentary and involves extended periods of computer use, including repetitive data entry, navigating databases, creating and modifying electronic documents, and using email and the internet. The laboratory environment can be noisy, fast-paced, and stressful, and the position may require working under stressful emergency response conditions. The employee may also be required to move objects and materials weighing up to 25 pounds.

Schedule:
Standard DOH business hours are Monday to Friday 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. This position has a work schedule of 40 hours per week; however, the position may be expected to work longer hours to complete projects or assignments, and/or meeting business demands and deadlines, and/or during the annual legislative session. An alternative or flexible work schedule may be considered at the employee's request, subject to supervisory approval.

Travel Requirements:
Travel is not required to perform the duties of this position; however occasional or infrequent travel may be expected to attend meetings, trainings, or conferences.

When driving for state business, the employee must be able to legally operate a state or privately-owned vehicle; OR provide alternate transportation while on state business.

Tools & Equipment:
This position uses standard office furniture and equipment, such as a desk, office chair, cell phone, computer, monitor(s), keyboard, and mouse; and when in the office, the position may also require the use of a printer, phone, fax machine, and/or copy machine. This position requires reliable access to an internet connection sufficient to perform all job duties remotely.

Customer Interactions:
The position regularly requires engaging with customers in a variety of settings including agency staff, managers, and supervisors, legislators, governor's office staff, local health jurisdictions, federal government, State Board of Health, external partners, and statewide professional associations.

Other:
This position is covered by a bargaining unit for which the Washington Federation of State Employees (WFSE) is the exclusive representative. The DOH campus is a smoke-free, drug-free, alcohol-free, scent-neutral environment. This position may be required to conduct and/or participate in public health emergency preparedness and response activities.

We Encourage You to Apply

Flex is transforming the fragmented $90B+ moving, storage, and last-mile delivery industry into a seamless, technology-driven experience. Our two-sided marketplace connects customers with a nationwide network of independent drivers and movers.

As Program Manager, Marketplace Quality
, you will own the programs that drive provider quality, reliability, and performance across Flex's marketplace. You'll get into the field to understand our services firsthand, establish quality standards across reliability, customer ratings, and job execution, and build scalable programs that ensure providers are qualified, trained, and incentivized to deliver exceptional customer experiences.

This role requires strong technical and analytical acumen
to partner closely with Product, Engineering, Data, and Operations to design and implement algorithmic quality management systems, gamification, provider scoring, and automated performance programs
. You'll help shape how provider performance influences ratings, incentives, earnings opportunities, badges, and job prioritization, creating a marketplace where high-quality service is consistently rewarded and underperformance is addressed at scale.

This role is open to USA remote, with need-based travel to our offices and operating markets. Applicants must be authorized to work full-time in the US without visa sponsorship.

Core Responsibilities

Marketplace Quality & Reliability:
Develop measurable quality standards across service execution, on-time arrivals, fulfillment, cancellations, no-shows, and customer satisfaction.
Field Quality & Service Standards:
Spend time in the field understanding Flex's services, evaluating job execution, identifying quality gaps, and translating insights into network-wide standards.
Scoring & Gamification:
Design provider scoring systems, performance tiers, badges, rewards, and incentive programs that link quality and reliability to earnings opportunities and job prioritization.
Algorithmic Quality Management:
Partner with Product and Engineering to develop automated performance monitoring, quality-based matching, accountability mechanisms, eligibility controls, and remediation workflows.
Training & Qualifications:
Own provider training, certifications, qualification standards, and ongoing eligibility requirements.
Performance Management:
Build scalable quality audits, performance monitoring, and improvement programs that reward strong performance and address recurring service failures.
Cross-Functional Execution:
Partner with Product, Engineering, Data, and Operations to translate quality strategies into scalable technology solutions and measurable outcomes.

Key Requirements

Marketplace Experience:
4+ years in marketplace operations, supply quality, or program management, with direct experience designing and managing quality programs within a gig economy or two-sided marketplace.
Quality Systems:
Proven experience developing provider scoring, ratings, gamification, incentive, or automated performance management programs.
Technical & Analytical Acumen:
Strong ability to work with data, define scoring logic and automated decision frameworks, and translate operational requirements into technical specifications alongside Product and Engineering.
Operational Understanding:
Ability to evaluate frontline service delivery, identify root causes of quality issues, and translate field observations into scalable operational standards.
Marketplace Dynamics:
Deep understanding of provider reliability, supply engagement, retention, and quality enforcement trade-offs.
Program Leadership:
Proven ability to independently design, launch, and scale cross-functional programs in a fast-paced environment.

What Success Looks Like

You'll start by getting into the field, experiencing Flex's moving and storage services firsthand, and understanding what drives exceptional service across our driver and mover network. You'll translate those insights into clear, measurable quality standards
across provider reliability, customer ratings, and job execution.

Working with Product, Engineering, Data, and Operations, you'll build a scalable, algorithmic quality management program
that uses gamification, scoring, incentives, and automated interventions to influence provider behavior.

Ultimately, you'll create a system where provider quality directly influences ratings, rewards, earnings opportunities, badges, and job prioritization
, consistently rewarding high performers and addressing underperformance.

Success means building a self-reinforcing marketplace where quality drives opportunity, providers are motivated to deliver exceptional service, and network-wide performance improves as Flex scales without proportional increases in manual oversight.

new_jobs.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Project Manager based in France.

As Project Manager, you will play an essential role in coordinating and supporting the delivery of professional security services for blockchain and decentralised finance (DeFi) projects. You will work closely with client engagement teams and technical security specialists, ensuring that projects progress smoothly from initial kickoff through final delivery. Your responsibilities will include managing project tasks, coordinating meetings, tracking action items and maintaining clear communication between stakeholders. You will help minimise administrative workloads for engineers, allowing them to focus on delivering high-quality security solutions. Working in a fully remote, international and technically driven environment, you will contribute to building trusted client relationships and ensuring operational excellence. This is an excellent opportunity to develop your project management expertise while gaining exposure to cybersecurity, blockchain technology and complex technical engagements.

Accountabilities

Support the coordination and execution of client security engagements, taking ownership of assigned tasks and ensuring activities are completed according to established processes and instructions.
Maintain accurate and up-to-date project task trackers, ensuring that delivery teams and leadership have clear visibility into progress, priorities, deadlines and outstanding actions.
Attend internal and client meetings, document key discussions, capture decisions and create clear action items with assigned owners and deadlines.
Proactively follow up on outstanding tasks and action items, ensuring that commitments are tracked and completed within agreed timelines.
Monitor client communication channels, particularly Slack, identifying questions, emerging risks, delivery blockers and potential signs of reduced customer engagement.
Reduce administrative workloads for security engineers by coordinating meetings, tracking access requests and ensuring customer requirements are properly documented and ready for action.
Assist in preparing regular project status reports and updates for leadership, clients and relevant stakeholders.
Participate in customer meetings to develop an understanding of client relationship management, stakeholder communication and trust-building practices.
Learn, understand and consistently apply internal policies, project management tools, operational procedures and service delivery standards.
Identify opportunities to improve coordination, communication and administrative processes to support efficient project execution.

Requirements

Between 1 and 3 years of experience in project coordination, project management, operations or a similar position within a technical or professional services environment. Internships and co-op experience are also considered.
Excellent organisational skills and attention to detail, with the ability to manage multiple tasks, track outstanding actions and ensure that nothing is overlooked.
Strong written communication skills, particularly in preparing accurate meeting notes, documenting decisions and producing clear, concise project updates.
Proactive communication habits, including regularly sharing progress, anticipating potential issues, asking relevant questions and seeking support when facing blockers.
Strong interpersonal and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively with engineers, project stakeholders and client-facing teams.
Coachable mindset and willingness to actively seek feedback, learn from colleagues and continuously improve professional performance.
Genuine curiosity about cybersecurity and an interest in understanding how complex technical security projects and programmes are delivered.
Ability to work independently, manage priorities and remain organised in a fully remote and distributed working environment.
Nice to have: Entry-level project management certifications such as CAPM, Google Project Management Certificate, Scrum Fundamentals or equivalent qualifications.
Nice to have: Familiarity with project management and collaboration platforms, task-tracking systems and communication tools.
Nice to have: Previous exposure to customer-facing responsibilities, client coordination or stakeholder support.
Nice to have: Academic or professional background in Computer Science, Software Development, Cybersecurity or another technical discipline.
Nice to have: Familiarity with blockchain technology, Layer 1 and Layer 2 networks, decentralised finance (DeFi) or related ecosystems.

Benefits

Competitive compensation: Attractive base salary aligned with the responsibilities and experience required for the position.
Performance incentives: Lucrative bonus programmes offering additional earning potential.
Paid time off: More than 25 days of annual paid leave to support work-life balance and personal wellbeing.
Home office support: Comprehensive allowances and stipends to help create an effective and comfortable remote working environment.
Wellbeing benefits: Dedicated stipends to support physical and mental health.
Professional development: Financial support for learning, training, certifications and career development opportunities.
Retirement planning: Access to pension or 401(k) programmes, depending on the applicable employment arrangement and location.
Life insurance: Coverage designed to provide additional financial protection and peace of mind.
Healthcare coverage: Premium healthcare benefits.
Fully remote culture: Opportunity to work remotely alongside an experienced international team.
Technical exposure: Gain valuable experience working with cybersecurity specialists and supporting complex security engagements across blockchain and DeFi ecosystems.
Professional growth: Develop project coordination, stakeholder management and technical programme delivery skills within a specialised security environment.

new_jobs.title: Supply Chain Data Analyst
new_jobs.description:
Supply Chain Data Analyst

W2 Contract 3+ Months

San Francisco, CA 94108

$50–$60/hour

About the Opportunity

Tatcha is seeking a detail-oriented and analytical Supply Chain Planning Analyst to support its Supply Chain Planning team on a temporary assignment. This is an excellent opportunity for a data-driven professional who enjoys solving problems, improving data accuracy, and keeping supply chain operations running smoothly.

In this role, you'll work extensively in NetSuite and Excel to maintain critical inventory and planning data, troubleshoot discrepancies, and support reporting, product launches, and inventory management. The ideal candidate is highly organized, comfortable navigating complex datasets, and confident working independently to identify and resolve issues.

What You'll Do

NetSuite & Data Management

Execute mass updates and CSV imports in NetSuite, including item records, vendor information, and planning parameters.
Validate data before and after system updates to ensure accuracy and maintain detailed change logs.
Identify and correct outdated, duplicate, or inconsistent master data, including obsolete BOMs and inactive items.

Inventory & Supply Chain Support

Support inventory tracking and approvals for samples, gift-with-purchase items, and other complimentary products.
Monitor inventory levels against promotional program requirements, identifying potential shortages or excess.
Assist with product kits and sets by verifying bills of materials (BOMs), tracking component availability, and monitoring production timelines.
Support inventory and item data management for Tatcha.com, including product availability and channel allocations.
Reconcile ecommerce inventory and order data against NetSuite records, investigating and resolving discrepancies.

Reporting & Process Improvement

Generate and maintain recurring NetSuite reports and saved searches.
Analyze data and respond to reporting requests from the supply planning team.
Investigate data inconsistencies, document root causes, and help prevent recurring errors.
Communicate potential inventory or data issues proactively to support effective planning decisions.

What We're Looking For

4+ years of experience in supply chain, inventory management, operations analytics, or related data-focused roles.
Hands-on NetSuite experience, specifically with saved searches, mass updates, and CSV imports.
Strong Excel proficiency, including lookups, pivot tables, and working with large datasets.
Familiarity with bills of materials (BOMs), item master records, and inventory transactions.
Exceptional attention to detail and a commitment to data accuracy.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to independently investigate discrepancies.
Excellent organization and communication skills, including the ability to identify issues early and keep stakeholders informed.

Nice to Have

Experience in beauty, skincare, consumer packaged goods (CPG), or related industries.
Familiarity with product kitting, gift-with-purchase programs, or promotional inventory.
Experience supporting direct-to-consumer (DTC) ecommerce operations.
